title: Potentials of individual atoms by convergent beam electron diffraction
summary: In convergent beam electron diffraction (CBED) on two-dimensional (2D) materials, the intensity distributions within the individual CBED spots map the local atomic arrangements within the probed region. In this study we demonstrate that the average intensities within the CBED spots essentially depend on the scattering parameters by a single atom, thus, offering the possibility of the direct measurement of such parameters. Scattering potential of an individual atom can be approximated by the Gaussian function and its parameters, the standard deviation and the maximal phase shift, can be recovered from the ratio of the intensities in the zero- and higher orders spots in CBED pattern. In order to demonstrate this, we simulated CBED patterns and extracted the atomic scattering parameters from such patterns. In the simulated examples, no weak phase object approximation is applied and the proposed method provides accurate results even for materials with large phase shifts up to 1.5 rad, as for example tungsten. The scattering parameters recovered from the experimental CBED patterns of graphene and twisted graphene-hBN structure show good agreement with the theoretically obtained values.

AI.tldr: 提出一种通过CBED斑点平均强度比值直接测量单个原子散射参数（高斯型散射势的标准差与最大相移）的方法，模拟与石墨烯/扭角石墨烯-hBN实验均验证有效。
AI.motivation: 二维材料CBED中斑点内强度分布反映局部原子排布，但缺乏从CBED图案直接、定量提取单个原子散射参数（散射势）的简便途径，尤其在大相移材料中受弱相位物体近似限制。
AI.method: 将单个原子散射势近似为高斯函数，用零阶与高阶CBED斑点内平均强度之比反演高斯参数（标准差与最大相移）；通过模拟CBED图案（不采用弱相位物体近似）提取参数，并应用于石墨烯及扭角石墨烯-hBN的实验CBED图案。
AI.result: 模拟中方法在最大相移高达1.5 rad的材料（如钨）上仍给出准确结果；石墨烯与扭角石墨烯-hBN实验CBED图案恢复的散射参数与理论值吻合良好。
AI.conclusion: CBED斑点平均强度比可作为一种直接、无需弱相位物体近似的单原子散射参数测量手段，适用于二维材料乃至大相移体系。

title: Universal model of the growth of III-V tetrahedral semiconductors on polar surfaces: pyramids and glue atoms. I. Clean surface properties
summary: Ab initio calculations were used to elucidate the properties of the polar surfaces of III-V tetrahedral semiconductors, i.e., metal- and nonmetal-terminated. The systems considered were clean wurtzite gallium nitride (i.e. (0001) and (000-1) GaN surfaces), zinc blende gallium phosphide (i.e. (111) and (-1-1-1) GaP), gallium arsenide (i.e. (111) and (-1-1-1) GaAs), and (111) and (-1-1-1) GaSb surfaces. The calculated data include the crystallographic structure and the electronic states of the termination atoms on both sides, i.e. their positions, energies, and occupations. All nonmetal-terminated surfaces exhibit no reconstruction, and their broken-bond states are located in the vicinity of the valence band maxima (VBM), pinning the Fermi level. The Ga-terminated surface exhibited (4 x 4) reconstruction related to the division of termination atoms into sp3 and sp2 hybridized in proportions of 6 to 10, based on charge redistribution according to the electron counting rule (ECR). Thus, the broken-bond state is separated into two sets, occupied and empty, with the Fermi level located between them in the vicinity of the conduction band minimum (CBM).

AI.tldr: 用第一性原理计算系统研究III-V族四面体半导体极性表面（金属与非金属终止），揭示其重构与电子态特征。
AI.motivation: 极性表面（金属/非金属终止）的性质对III-V族半导体器件至关重要，但缺乏系统性的从头计算比较研究，尤其关于重构与费米能级钉扎机制。
AI.method: 采用ab initio（第一性原理）计算，考察洁净的(0001)/(000-1) GaN（纤锌矿）、以及(111)/(-1-1-1)的GaP、GaAs、GaSb（闪锌矿）表面。计算内容含晶体结构及两侧终止原子的位置、能量与占据态。
AI.result: 非金属终止表面均无重构，断键态位于价带顶（VBM）附近并钉扎费米能级。Ga终止表面出现(4×4)重构，终止原子按电子计数规则（ECR）分为sp3与sp2杂化，比例约6:10，断键态分裂为占据与空态两组，费米能级位于其间、靠导带底（CBM）附近。
AI.conclusion: III-V极性表面呈现鲜明的非对称行为：非金属终止表面稳定无重构且费米能级钉扎于VBM；金属终止表面通过电荷重分布驱动的(4×4)重构使费米能级移至带隙中上部。ECR可有效解释表面重构与电子态分裂。

title: Universal model of the growth of III-V tetrahedral semiconductors on polar surfaces: pyramids and glue atoms. II. Adsorption of nonmetal atoms (N, P, As, and Sb) on Ga-terminated surfaces
summary: Ab initio calculations were used to simulate the adsorption processes on Ga-terminated surfaces of tetrahedral semiconductors: GaN, GaP, GaAs and GaSb. The considered adsorbates are nonmetal species, i.e., nitrogen, phosphorus, arsenic, and antimony on wurtzite gallium nitride, i.e., GaN(0001) surfaces, zinc blende gallium phosphide, i.e., GaP(111), gallium arsenide, GaAs(111), and gallium antimonide, GaSb (111) surfaces. The cases investigated include single adsorbed nonmetal atoms and full coverage, i.e. theta=1 of these surfaces. The calculated results include the stable sites and the energies of the single adsorbed atoms: located at H3 sites at low coverage and in on-top positions at high coverage for GaP, GaAs and GaSb. At high nitrogen coverage, the N2 admolecules are formed, weakly attached to the surface. The calculated electronic properties of the single-adatom systems include the band diagrams of the slabs in real and momentum space, the energies of the quantum states. In addition, the overlaps of the quantum states of the nonmetal adatoms and the nearest topmost surface Ga atoms are given. The full coverage data include the atomic configurations and the bond energies of the adsorbed layers. The electronic properties include the above-mentioned data for single adatoms, together with additional properties related to interactions between adsorbed atoms. The evaporation stability analysis confirms that the adatoms stabilize the topmost Ga atoms against detachment because of the high energy barrier of DE > 3 eV which is further increased to DE > 4 eV by coverage located at H3 sites. Thus, growth simulations should employ unreconstructed Ga-terminated surfaces covered by nonmetal atoms located at on-top positions.

AI.tldr: 采用第一性原理计算模拟了非金属原子(N、P、As、Sb)在GaN、GaP、GaAs、GaSb的Ga终止表面的吸附过程，涵盖单原子吸附与全覆盖两种情况，揭示了稳定吸附位点随覆盖度变化的规律及吸附对表面稳定性的影响。
AI.motivation: 为理解Ga终止的四面体半导体表面在非金属吸附下的行为，并指导晶体生长模拟中应采用的合理表面模型（是否需要重构、覆盖何种原子）。
AI.method: 使用从头算(第一性原理)方法计算非金属原子在GaN(0001)纤锌矿及GaP、GaAs、GaSb(111)闪锌矿Ga终止表面的吸附，考察单原子与全覆盖(theta=1)两类情形，分析稳定吸附位、能量、能带图(实空间与动量空间)、量子态能量、吸附原子与最近表层Ga原子的态重叠、原子构型与键能，以及蒸发稳定性。
AI.result: 低覆盖时吸附原子位于H3位，高覆盖时GaP、GaAs、GaSb处于on-top位；高氮覆盖下形成弱吸附的N2分子。吸附原子通过高脱附能垒(DE>3 eV)稳定表层Ga原子，H3位覆盖可将其进一步提高到DE>4 eV。
AI.conclusion: 非金属吸附能显著抑制表层Ga原子的脱附，因而生长模拟应采用被非金属原子占据on-top位、未重构的Ga终止表面模型。

title: Mirror-symmetry engineering of altermagnetism based on monolayer hexagonal lattices
summary: Altermagnetism (AM) is a novel collinear antiferromagnetic phase characterized by spin-polarized bands and zero net magnetization. However, realizing AM in monolayer hexagonal lattices is strongly constrained by lattice symmetry. Here, we propose a mirror-symmetry-based design principle and implementation scheme for realizing AM based on monolayer hexagonal lattices and validate it using holey graphyne (HGY) as a representative system. By examining hydrogenated nonmetal units X$-$H (X = B, C, N, P, and S) introduced along the mirror-symmetry axis and extending the analysis to N$-$F, we identify the configurations that form two antiparallel spin sublattices related by mirror reflection. The N$-$H structure forms a stable altermagnetic ground state, with a momentum-dependent spin splitting up to 148.2 meV. The magnetism originates from $π-π$ superexchange interactions, and H/F functionalization stabilizes intrinsic AM by regulating the local charge distribution. Our work offers insights into the design of light-element altermagnetic materials.

AI.tldr: 提出基于镜面对称的单层六角晶格交错磁（AM）设计原则，并以多孔石墨炔（HGY）为代表体系验证，N-H修饰可实现稳定AM基态，自旋劈裂达148.2 meV。
AI.motivation: 交错磁兼具自旋极化能带与零净磁化，但在单层六角晶格中受晶格对称性严格限制，难以实现，需要新的设计原则。
AI.method: 以多孔石墨炔（HGY）为原型，沿镜面对称轴引入氢化非金属单元X-H（X=B、C、N、P、S）并扩展至N-F，构建由镜面反射联系的两个反平行自旋子晶格；通过第一性原理计算分析稳定性、磁性与自旋劈裂，并解析磁性来源。
AI.result: N-H构型形成稳定的交错磁基态，动量依赖的自旋劈裂最高达148.2 meV；磁性源于π-π超交换作用，H/F功能化通过调节局域电荷分布稳定本征AM。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出单层六角晶格实现交错磁的镜面对称设计原则，为轻元素交错磁材料的设计提供思路。

title: Finite-time Mpemba crossings with imperfect preparation
summary: Two preparations evolving under the same thermal Markov generator can reverse their ordering in relative entropy even when the hotter state retains a nonzero slow-mode component. We derive a sufficient finite-time crossing condition for arbitrary finite irreducible reversible systems. The condition compares the preparations' weights in the entire slowest eigenspace, including degeneracies, and gives an explicit upper bound using the separation from the next distinct decay rate. Exact finite-amplitude entropy comparisons also yield all-mode enclosures and bounds based on a retained spectrum with a controlled omitted tail. A preparation-error inequality converts finite-time sign margins into explicit probability tolerances; extensions account for temperature, generator, and stationary-reference uncertainty. We test the bounds on 2000 predefined network draws with four graph families and 4--64 states. There are 86 numerically located crossings, of which 45 satisfy the simple sufficient condition. In a selected eight-state example, retaining two nonstationary modes certifies a crossing before 1.55163, improving a certified slow-sector endpoint of 2.53951; the located crossing is near 1.26943. A reflecting diffusion in an asymmetric potential supplies a separate physical example, with systematic mesh refinement. Independent interval arithmetic certifies selected spectral bounds, finite-grid first crossings, and an entire preparation-temperature rectangle in a three-state benchmark. The theorem does not require exact slow-mode cancellation, while its numerical sharpness and detection coverage remain model dependent. These results concern relative-entropy relaxation and do not predict water-freezing times.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究热马尔可夫生成元下两个初始制备的相对熵排序可在有限时间内反转的现象，给出任意有限不可约可逆系统的充分有限时间交叉条件，并辅以谱界、误差容限与数值/物理示例验证。
AI.motivation: 传统直觉认为较热状态相对熵更大且会单调衰减，但实际有限时间演化中，即使较热状态仍含非零慢模成分，相对熵排序也可能发生反转。作者希望给出可判定、可计算的有限时间交叉判据及严格的数值证书，澄清相对熵弛豫的有限时间行为（并明确不涉及类似水结冰时间的预测）。
AI.method: 推导适用于任意有限不可约可逆系统的充分有限时间交叉条件，比较两制备在最慢本征子空间（含简并）上的权重，并利用与下一个不同衰减率的间隔给出显式上界；通过精确有限幅度熵比较得到全模态包裹界及“保留谱+受控截断尾部”的界；建立制备误差不等式，将有限时间符号裕度转为概率容差，并扩展到温度、生成元和稳态参考的不确定性。数值上在4类图族、4–64状态、2000个预定义网络抽样上测试，并用区间算术独立验证谱界、有限网格首交叉以及三状态基准中的制备-温度矩形；另给出非对称势中反射扩散的物理例子并做网格细化。
AI.result: 2000个网络抽样中数值定位到86个交叉，其中45个满足简单充分条件；八状态示例中保留两个非稳态模可将交叉认证提前至1.55163（优于慢扇区端点2.53951，定位交叉约1.26943）。非对称势反射扩散例子在系统网格细化下给出独立物理示例；区间算术成功认证选定谱界、有限网格首交叉及三状态基准中的整个制备-温度矩形。
AI.conclusion: 定理不要求精确慢模抵消，但数值锐度与检测覆盖率依赖具体模型。结果为相对熵弛豫提供可认证的有限时间交叉判据与误差容限框架，属相对熵弛豫分析，不用于预测水结冰时间等实际物理时间尺度。

title: Underdamped Stochastic Optimal Transport with Landauer boundary conditions: machine learning and analytical solution
comment: Main: 12 pages, 6 figures. Supplemental material: 11 pages
summary: Finding optimal transport protocols for underdamped stochastic processes is a difficult yet important problem in control theory. In this paper we develop a direct method, based on machine learning, to find the optimal solution of the problem in the presence of non-linear boundary conditions, including those modelling the Landauer bit-erasure problem. The dynamics is steered from a single-peak to a double-peak distribution in position space, by only acting on a controllable external potential. The problem is highly non-linear, and analytical solutions are not available in general. We benchmark our numerical results with a perturbative expansion, which is expected to hold in a suitable overdamped limit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于机器学习的直接方法，用于求解欠阻尼随机过程在非线性边界条件（包括Landauer擦除问题）下的最优输运协议。
AI.motivation: 欠阻尼随机过程的最优输运协议是控制理论中的重要难题，非线性边界条件下缺乏解析解，需要数值方法。
AI.method: 基于机器学习（数值优化）的直接方法，仅通过可控制的外部势场将系统从单峰分布驱动到双峰分布；并与微扰展开（过阻尼极限下有效）进行基准对比。
AI.result: 给出了单峰到双峰输运的数值最优解，并与过阻尼极限下的微扰展开结果进行了基准比较。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习方法可有效处理欠阻尼随机最优输运中的非线性问题，为Landauer擦除等场景提供数值求解途径。

title: Microscopic structure at the morphotropic phase boundary in lead-barium meta-niobat
summary: Lead-barium niobate Pb$_{1-x}$Ba$_x$Nb$_2$O$_6$ is a tetragonal tungsten-bronze ferroelectric that exhibits enhanced functional properties near a morphotropic phase boundary separating orthorhombic and tetragonal phases. Using first-principles electronic-structure calculations combined with ab initio molecular dynamics, we investigate how Ba substitution modifies cation-site occupancy, local distortions, and polarization behavior across the solid solution. By explicitly accounting for vacancy ordering and the inequivalent $A$-site cages intrinsic to the tungsten-bronze framework, we identify the structural origin of the orthorhombic-to-tetragonal transition. Increasing Ba content progressively weakens the cooperative in-plane off-centering of Pb ions in the pentagonal channels and promotes out-of-plane displacements of Nb and $A$-site cations, leading to a rotation of the spontaneous polarization from [110] to [001]. The transition occurs near $x \approx 0.6$, in quantitative agreement with experimental phase diagrams. These results provide a microscopic interpretation of the morphotropic phase boundary in Pb$_{1-x}$Ba$_x$Nb$_2$O$_6$ and establish a clear structure-polarization relationship for tungsten-bronze ferroelectrics.

AI.tldr: 本文用第一性原理电子结构计算结合从头算分子动力学，研究Pb1-xBaxNb2O6中Ba替代如何改变A位占据、局域畸变与极化，揭示正交-四方相变及准同型相界的微观起源（x≈0.6）。
AI.motivation: Pb1-xBaxNb2O6是四方钨青铜铁电体，在正交与四方相之间的准同型相界附近性能增强，但其微观结构起源（Ba替代如何影响阳离子占位、局域畸变与极化）尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理电子结构计算结合从头算分子动力学；显式考虑空位有序化以及钨青铜骨架中不等价A位笼，系统扫描Ba含量x，追踪阳离子位占据、局域畸变与极化方向的变化。
AI.result: 随Ba含量增加，五边形通道中Pb离子的面内协同偏心位移逐渐减弱，Nb与A位阳离子的面外位移增强，自发极化由[110]转向[001]；相变发生在x≈0.6附近，与实验相图定量吻合。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了Pb1-xBaxNb2O6准同型相界的微观解释，并建立了钨青铜铁电体清晰的“结构—极化”关系。

title: Hierarchy of Electromagnetic Gauge Field Quantum Geometries
summary: The conventional Bloch quantum geometric tensor (QGT) describes electric-dipole geometry for spatially uniform perturbations and vertical Bloch transitions. We develop a broader framework linking quantum geometry to local and nonlocal electromagnetic response in gauge-field space, placing this tensor within a hierarchy of electric and magnetic multipole quantum geometries. The intrinsic antisymmetric adiabatic response in every electromagnetic channel is a Berry curvature in the space of its conjugate fields. The field-dependent projector uniquely fixes the QGT for that channel, pairing the response curvature with a quantum metric. This construction extends to spatially nonuniform perturbations, whose finite momentum transfer induces nonvertical Bloch transitions. We explicitly construct the current--current QGT connecting Bloch states at $\mathbf{k}\pm\mathbf{q}/2$, providing a unified metric and curvature description of nonlocal current response. In the doubled Brillouin zone, tangential derivatives generate conventional momentum-space QGT multipoles, whereas normal derivatives connect finite-momentum geometry to uniform electric- and magnetic-multipole-pair QGTs. We derive this connection through second order in $\mathbf{q}$. The finite-momentum curvature governs the intrinsic nonlocal Hall response, while an inverse-frequency moment of symmetric optical absorption probes the index-symmetric metric sector.

AI.tldr: 文章提出一个将量子几何与局域及非局域电磁响应联系起来的更广义框架，把传统Bloch量子几何张量(QGT)纳入电、磁多极量子几何的层级中，并构造了连接k±q/2 Bloch态的电流-电流QGT，用以统一描述非局域电流响应。
AI.motivation: 传统Bloch QGT仅描述空间均匀扰动下的电偶极几何和垂直Bloch跃迁，无法涵盖非局域(有限动量转移)响应及磁多极等更丰富的电磁通道，因此需要一个更普适的量子几何框架。
AI.method: 在规范场空间中构建量子几何，将每个电磁通道的本征反对称绝热响应表述为其共轭场空间中的Berry曲率；由场依赖投影算符唯一确定各通道的QGT，配对响应曲率与量子度规；推广至空间非均匀扰动，显式构造连接k±q/2 Bloch态的电流-电流QGT；在双倍布里渊区中，通过到q的二阶展开，用切向导数生成常规动量空间QGT多极，用法向导数连接有限动量几何与均匀电/磁多极对QGT。
AI.result: 建立了各通道中Berry曲率=共轭场空间曲率的普遍对应；给出电流-电流QGT的统一度规与曲率描述；表明有限动量曲率主导本征非局域Hall响应，而对称光吸收的逆频率矩可探测指数对称的度规部分。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将QGT扩展为电/磁多极量子几何的层级体系，把空间均匀与非均匀、局域与非局域、垂直与非垂直跃迁统一于同一几何框架，并指出曲率与度规分别对应非局域Hall响应与光吸收探测量。

title: Static and dynamic density correlations of interacting active Brownian particles
summary: We develop a stochastic Dean--Kawasaki field theory to predict the static structure factor and collective intermediate scattering function of interacting active Brownian particles. Starting from the microscopic overdamped dynamics, we derive coupled stochastic equations for the density and polarization fields using an angular-moment closure. Gaussian linearization then yields closed analytical expressions for static and dynamic density correlations in terms of propulsion speed, mean number density, interaction potential, translational and rotational diffusivities. The coupling between density and polarization predicts a crossover from exponential relaxation to damped oscillations despite the absence of inertia. For Gaussian-core potential, the predictions contain no fitting parameters. Brownian dynamics simulations show quantitative agreement at low activity and long wavelengths, and reproduce the crossover behaviour. For Weeks--Chandler--Andersen potential, the nonintegrable core makes both the Fourier transform of the potential and the self-interaction correction term in the Dean--Kawasaki field theory ill-defined. We therefore introduce an approximation that replaces the interaction potential with a passive direct-correlation function fitted separately at each density and temperature. This approximation requires no additional activity-dependent fitting parameters.

AI.tldr: 提出随机Dean-Kawasaki场论预测活性布朗粒子静态结构因子与集体中间散射函数，从过阻尼微观动力学经角矩封闭导出密度与极化场耦合方程，Gaussian线性化给出解析表达式，无惯性条件下预测指数松弛到阻尼振荡的转变。
AI.motivation: 活性布朗粒子的静态与动态密度关联缺乏同时能给出解析形式、且不含拟合参数的理论框架；相互作用与活性的耦合如何改变集体弛豫行为尚不清晰。
AI.method: 从过阻尼微观动力学出发，采用角矩封闭得到密度场与极化场的耦合随机方程；再做Gaussian线性化，得到以推进速度、平均密度、相互作用势、平动与转动扩散系数表示的静态与动态关联闭式解。针对Gaussian-core势无需拟合参数；针对WCA势因其不可积核心导致势的傅里叶变换与自作用修正项不适定，改用按密度和温度分别拟合的被动直接关联函数近似替换相互作用势，且不引入额外活性依赖参数。
AI.result: 密度-极化耦合预测出由指数松弛向阻尼振荡的转变，尽管体系无惯性。Gaussian-core势下预测无拟合参数，布朗动力学模拟在低活性与长波极限下定量吻合，并重现该转变行为。
AI.conclusion: 该场论为活性布朗粒子集体密度关联提供了解析、可检验的理论描述，揭示了活性驱动的类惯性振荡行为；直接关联函数近似为硬核势情形提供了无需额外拟合参数的处理途径。

title: Counting kinks and magnons with the lattice: magnetoelastic effects in Cs$_2$CoBr$_4$
summary: We report low-temperature dilatometry and ultrasound measurements on the frustrated quasi-one-dimensional antiferromagnet Cs$_2$CoBr$_4$ across the entire cascade of field-induced magnetic phase transitions. The whole phase diagram can be recovered from these lattice probes, with distinct anomalies observed at each phase boundary. Elongation along the principal chain axis is found to closely track magnetization throughout the phase diagram. This behavior is interpreted in terms of kinks in the Néel structure and magnons in the transverse-ordered magnetic-BEC phases, each carrying a fixed lattice distortion. A simultaneous analysis of ultrasound and striction data allows us to quantify the strength of magnetoelastic coupling.

AI.tldr: 通过低温膨胀测量与超声测量，在受挫准一维反铁磁体Cs2CoBr4的整个场致磁相变序列中恢复了完整相图，并量化了磁弹耦合强度。
AI.motivation: 该体系存在复杂的场诱导磁相变级联，需借助晶格探针独立于磁测量来标定相图，并理解磁性与晶格的关联机制。
AI.method: 对Cs2CoBr4进行低温热膨胀（dilatometry）与超声声速测量，覆盖全部场诱导相变；将沿主链轴的伸长量与磁化强度对比，并用"奈尔结构中的kink"与横向有序磁BEC相中的magnon（各携带固定晶格畸变）解释；同时联合拟合超声与strict ion数据。
AI.result: 各相边界均出现明显异常，可由晶格探针重构完整相图；沿主链轴伸长量与磁化强度高度吻合；由此定量给出磁弹耦合强度。
AI.conclusion: 晶格测量是追踪该受挫磁体相图的有效手段，磁化与应变的同步行为可由kink/ magnon携带固定畸变的图像统一描述，磁弹耦合强度得到定量确定。

title: Pair density waves via interband pairing --- a perspective from superfluid weight
summary: Pair density waves (PDW) are superconducting states that exhibit a spatially modulated pairing order parameter, corresponding to Cooper pairs carrying finite center-of-mass momentum. While some recent studies have emphasized the role of quantum geometry in stabilizing PDW order in certain multiband systems, we here present a systematic investigation of an alternative, geometry-independent mechanism: PDW order driven purely by interband Cooper pairing. Using the superfluid weight (SW) as a diagnostic, we study two canonical models. The first is the classic Fulde-Ferrell model of an $s$-wave superconductor subject to a Zeeman splitting field, which realizes pure interband pairing between two rigidly shifted bands; the second is a spinless honeycomb-lattice model with nearest-neighbor $f$-wave pairing, a modified version of which was recently found to exhibit PDW instability in density-matrix renormalization-group simulations. In both models the SW receives no quantum geometric contribution at the mean-field level, yet it can be greatly suppressed or even turn negative, signaling a tendency toward pairing with spatial phase modulations. For the first model, we establish that the SW is increasingly suppressed as the Zeeman field grows, drastically turning negative upon the emergence of extensive gapless excitations, i.e., the Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces. For the honeycomb $f$-wave model, we demonstrate, both analytically and numerically, vanishing quantum-geometric SW and an invariably negative total SW. Our results thus establish the SW as a qualitative indicator of the tendency toward PDW order, and provide a microscopic rationale for the interband-pairing-driven PDW instability.

AI.tldr: 该文系统研究仅由带间配对驱动的PDW机制，表明在无量子几何贡献时超流权重仍可被大幅压低甚至变负，从而作为PDW倾向的定性判据。
AI.motivation: 近期研究强调量子几何在多带体系稳定PDW中的作用，作者希望考察一种不依赖几何的替代机制，即纯带间库珀配对是否足以驱动PDW不稳定性。
AI.method: 以超流权重(SW)为诊断量，研究两个典型模型：(1) 受Zeeman场作用的s波超导FF模型，实现两刚性平移带间的纯带间配对；(2) 最近邻f波配对的无自旋蜂窝晶格模型（其变体在DMRG中被发现具PDW不稳定性）。结合解析与数值计算，区分量子几何贡献与总SW。
AI.result: 两模型在平均场层面SW均无量子几何贡献。FF模型中SW随Zeeman场增大而单调压低，在出现大量无能隙激发（Bogoliubov费米面）时急剧转负；蜂窝f波模型中解析与数值均给出量子几何SW为零、总SW恒为负。
AI.conclusion: SW可作为PDW倾向的定性指标，并给出带间配对驱动PDW不稳定性的微观解释，说明PDW稳定并不必然依赖量子几何。

title: Evaluating Instrument-Centered AI Agents for Table-Top Science Experiments
comment: 36 pages (26 main text + 10 supplemental material), 14 figures, 5 tables. Code: https://github.com/caidish/instrMCP and https://github.com/caidish/qdevbench
summary: Reliable evaluation of AI agents for table-top science experiments has remained elusive because live instruments are hard to reset and share at scale, while instrument statefulness and safety constraints complicate evaluation. We introduce instrMCP and q-devBench, an evaluation stack for instrument-centered AI agents in table-top experiments. instrMCP connects coding agents to scientific instruments through the Model Context Protocol, serving as the instrument-access harness. q-devBench reconstructs 37 real experimental tasks from condensed-matter physics as virtual QCoDeS instruments covering quantum electronic transport, scanning probe imaging, and calibration workflows. q-devBench exposes reproducible failure modes in laboratory-agent systems while preserving realistic instrument-control workflows. Across a range of commercial coding-agent configurations, current systems already show substantial operational competence, satisfying 70-83% of measurement-related rubric criteria. The main bottleneck is scientific analysis, where performance falls to 28-46%. In an analysis-only ablation in which agents receive clean reference datasets without running the virtual measurement session, analysis performance improves substantially, closing roughly two thirds of the difference between the measurement and analysis scores. This suggests that much of the deficit arises from the measurement-session context, including tool-use overhead, longer context, measurement-planning decisions, and possible acquisition errors, while a residual scientific-reasoning gap remains. Together, instrMCP and q-devBench provide a practical sandbox for benchmarking, diagnosing, and improving laboratory AI harnesses, and establish a route from controlled virtual evaluation to future live-hardware validation.

AI.tldr: 提出 instrMCP 与 q-devBench 评测栈，用于基准测试桌面实验中以仪器为中心的 AI 智能体：通过 MCP 连接编码智能体与虚拟 QCoDeS 仪器，重建 37 个凝聚态物理真实实验任务。现有智能体测量类标准满足率 70-83%，但科学分析仅 28-46%，主要瓶颈在于测量会话语境。
AI.motivation: 真实仪器难以规模化重置与共享，仪器有状态性与安全约束使在线评测困难，导致桌面科学实验 AI 智能体缺乏可靠可复现的评测手段。
AI.method: instrMCP 作为仪器访问工具层，通过 Model Context Protocol 把编码智能体接入科学仪器；q-devBench 将 37 个凝聚态物理真实实验任务重构为虚拟 QCoDeS 仪器，覆盖量子电子输运、扫描探针成像与校准流程，并保持真实仪器控制工作流。另设"仅分析"消融实验，向智能体直接提供干净参考数据集以分离测量会话与科学推理的影响。
AI.result: 多种商用编码智能体配置下，测量相关评分标准满足率达 70-83%，展现较强操作能力；但科学分析表现降至 28-46%。仅分析消融中分析表现显著提升，弥补测量与分析得分差距的约三分之二，表明大部分缺口源于测量会话语境（工具使用开销、更长上下文、测量规划决策、可能的采集错误），而剩余为科学推理差距。
AI.conclusion: instrMCP 与 q-devBench 提供了可用于基准测试、诊断与改进实验室 AI 工具链的实用沙箱，并开辟了从受控虚拟评测走向未来真实硬件验证的路径。

title: Dipolar Exciton Polarons in a van der Waals Homobilayer
summary: Fermi polarons exemplify how many-body interactions give rise to emergent quasiparticles, providing a fundamental framework for understanding interacting quantum matter. In electron-doped two-dimensional semiconductors, exciton polarons offer optical access to Fermi-polaron physics and electrical tunability, yet achieving stronger and more controllable exciton-electron interactions remains a key challenge. Here, we realize dipolar exciton polarons in an electrically tunable van der Waals homobilayer, where interlayer excitons with spatially separated electrons and holes act as quantum impurities carrying permanent electric dipole moments. These dipolar polarons exhibit substantially enhanced exciton-electron interactions, with binding energies more than four times those of conventional intralayer exciton polarons. We further demonstrate that Fermi-sea layer polarization provides an additional degree of freedom for controlling many-body interactions. In particular, the presence of a Fermi sea induces hybridization between oppositely oriented dipolar polarons, whereas confining the Fermi sea to a single layer suppresses this hybridization and produces orientation-selective many-body dressing. Our findings establish an experimental platform for dipolar-polaron physics in which dipole orientation and Fermi-sea layer polarization jointly govern many-body interactions, opening a route towards electrically tunable interactions and dipolar-polaron-mediated attraction between itinerant electrons.

AI.tldr: 在电可调范德华同质双层中实现偶极激子极化子，其激子-电子结合能是常规层内极化子的四倍以上，并通过费米海层极化调控多体相互作用与极化子杂化。
AI.motivation: 二维电子掺杂半导体中激子极化子可光学探测费米极化子物理并具电学可调性，但如何获得更强、更可控的激子-电子相互作用仍是关键挑战。
AI.method: 利用范德华同质双层中的层间激子（电子与空穴空间分离、具永久电偶极矩）作为量子杂质，构建偶极激子极化子；并通过费米海的层极化（单层或双层分布）调控多体相互作用。
AI.result: 偶极极化子的激子-电子结合能超过常规层内激子极化子的四倍；费米海存在时，取向相反的偶极极化子发生杂化；将费米海限制在单层则抑制该杂化，产生取向选择性的多体修饰。
AI.conclusion: 建立了偶极极化子物理的实验平台，其中偶极取向与费米海层极化共同调控多体相互作用，为电可调相互作用及偶极极化子介导的巡游电子间吸引提供途径。

title: Spontaneous Circular Dichroism and Memory Effect from Surface Defects in Altermagnetic MnTe
summary: Altermagnetism has emerged as a new class of magnetism with vanishing magnetization and macroscopic time reversal symmetry breaking. Hexagonal MnTe is a g-wave altermagnet with a 307 K Néel temperature, large spin splitting, and an anomalous Hall effect. However, the relationship between altermagnetism and the anomalous Hall effect in MnTe remains debated. Here, using optical magnetic circular dichroism, we observe hysteresis and a memory effect in a MnTe bulk crystal below 250 K. No hysteresis is seen after polishing the bulk crystal and in thin films. We conclude that the hysteresis in magnetic circular dichroism in the bulk crystal is from surface defects. The similar temperature dependence and a sign change between circular dichroism and the anomalous Hall effect indicate that the origin of the anomalous Hall effect in transport is likely not intrinsic.

AI.tldr: 通过光学磁圆二色性测量发现MnTe体单晶在250 K以下出现磁滞与记忆效应，但抛光和薄膜样品无此现象，归因于表面缺陷；据此认为MnTe反常霍尔效应很可能非内禀起源。
AI.motivation: 六方MnTe是g波交替磁体（奈尔温度307 K），具大自旋劈裂和反常霍尔效应，但交替磁性与反常霍尔效应之间的关系仍存在争议，需要实验厘清其起源。
AI.method: 采用光学磁圆二色性（MCD）测量MnTe体单晶，并对比抛光体单晶与薄膜样品的磁滞行为；结合MCD与输运反常霍尔效应的温度依赖及符号变化进行比较分析。
AI.result: 体单晶在250 K以下出现MCD磁滞和记忆效应，抛光体单晶与薄膜中均无磁滞，说明体单晶的磁滞源于表面缺陷；MCD与反常霍尔效应具有相似的温度依赖但符号相反。
AI.conclusion: 体单晶MCD磁滞来自表面缺陷而非本征交替磁性；由于温度依赖相似且符号相反，MnTe中的反常霍尔效应很可能不是内禀起源。

title: Creating functional nanostructures for vortex manipulation in superconducting Bi$_\text{2}$Sr$_\text{2}$CaCu$_\text{2}$O$_\text{8+x}$ thin films via focused He ion beam irradiation
summary: Bi$_2$Sr$_2$CaCu$_2$O$_{8+x}$ (Bi-2212) is a highly anisotropic high-temperature superconductor exhibiting unique vortex dynamics due to its layered structure. Precise nanoscale patterning of ultrathin Bi-2212 films remains challenging, limiting controlled studies of vortex pinning. Here, we employ 30 keV focused helium ion beam (He-FIB) irradiation to fabricate periodic arrays of columnar defects with 100 nm spacings in optimally-doped Bi-2212 thin films, thereby creating artificial vortex pinning centers. Magnetotransport measurements reveal pronounced vortex matching effects, evidenced by minima in magnetoresistance and peaks in critical current at commensurate magnetic fields. The angular dependence of magnetoresistance and critical current scale with an effective magnetic field, indicating strong confinement of pancake vortices along irradiation-induced tracks. These findings demonstrate the efficacy of He-FIB nanopatterning in modulating the superconducting properties in Bi-2212 thin films, providing a platform for fundamental studies of vortex matter and advancing prospects for device applications based on this highly anisotropic superconductor.

AI.tldr: 利用30 keV聚焦氦离子束在最优掺杂Bi-2212薄膜中制备100 nm间距的柱状缺陷阵列，观察到显著的磁通匹配效应，并证实饼状涡旋被强约束于辐照轨迹中。
AI.motivation: Bi-2212是强各向异性高温超导体，其层状结构导致独特涡旋动力学；但超薄Bi-2212薄膜的纳米尺度精确图案化困难，限制了对涡旋钉扎的受控研究。
AI.method: 采用30 keV聚焦氦离子束（He-FIB）辐照最优掺杂Bi-2212薄膜，制备间距100 nm的周期性柱状缺陷阵列作为人工涡旋钉扎中心，并进行磁输运测量（磁阻与临界电流随磁场、角度的变化）。
AI.result: 在匹配磁场处观察到明显的涡旋匹配效应：磁阻出现极小值、临界电流出现峰值；磁阻与临界电流的角度依赖关系可用有效磁场标度，表明饼状涡旋沿辐照轨迹被强约束。
AI.conclusion: He-FIB纳米图案化可有效调控Bi-2212薄膜的超导性质，为涡旋物质基础研究提供平台，并推动基于该强各向异性超导体的器件应用。

title: Full-Potential Korringa Kohn Rostoker Study of Structural and Mechanical Properties in SiGeSn Alloys
summary: Accurate first-principles descriptions of open, covalently bonded crystal structures remain challenging within conventional Korringa--Kohn--Rostoker (KKR) approaches owing to the spherical approximations commonly employed for the effective crystal potential. Here, we systematically assess the recently developed full-potential KKR (KKR-FP) implementation in the open-source MuST package and demonstrate its applicability to diamond-structured group-IV semiconductors and SiGeSn alloys. Benchmark calculations for diamond-structured Si reveal substantial limitations of the conventional muffin-tin and atomic sphere approximations, whereas KKR-FP accurately reproduces the experimental equilibrium lattice parameter and bulk modulus, yielding 5.433 and 94.9 GPa. The full-potential treatment also recovers the semiconducting character of Si. Further calculations for elemental Ge and Sn establish the applicability of the approach across group-IV materials. Extending this framework to SiGeSn alloys, we investigate their composition-dependent equilibrium lattice parameters, bulk moduli, and mixing enthalpies. The calculated lattice parameters exhibit positive deviations from Vegard's law, while the bulk modulus decreases substantially with changes in alloy composition. Moreover, positive mixing enthalpies of 180.92 and 346.32 meV/atom are obtained for Si0.5Ge0.375Sn0.125 and Si0.375Ge0.25Sn0.375, respectively, indicating an energetic penalty for homogeneous alloy formation relative to the selected elemental reference states. These findings highlight the importance of nonspherical potential contributions in accurately describing open-structured semiconductors and establish KKR-FP within MuST as a promising framework for investigating the structural properties and mixing energetics of compositionally complex group-IV alloys

AI.tldr: 评估MuST中全势KKR方法对金刚石结构IV族半导体及SiGeSn合金的描述能力，证明其显著优于传统球近似并给出合金结构/能量性质。
AI.motivation: 传统KKR采用muffin-tin/原子球近似处理有效晶体势，难以准确描述开放型共价键晶体结构，需要验证新发展的全势KKR（KKR-FP）在此类体系中的适用性。
AI.method: 在开源MuST软件包中系统测试KKR-FP实现，对金刚石结构Si、Ge、Sn及SiGeSn合金进行第一性原理计算，考察平衡晶格常数、体模量、电子结构与混合焓。
AI.result: Si的KKR-FP给出平衡晶格常数5.433 Å与体模量94.9 GPa，与实验吻合，并正确恢复其半导体性质；球近似则存在明显偏差。SiGeSn合金晶格参数相对Vegard定律呈正偏离，体模量随成分显著下降；Si0.5Ge0.375Sn0.125与Si0.375Ge0.25Sn0.375的混合焓分别为180.92和346.32 meV/atom，为正值。
AI.conclusion: 非球形势贡献对开放结构半导体至关重要；MuST中的KKR-FP是研究复杂成分IV族合金结构与混合能量的可靠框架。

title: Magnetic control of reflectionless states and an intrinsic-mode exceptional point in a magnon-phonon coupling system
summary: Reflectionless states (RLs) and exceptional points (EPs) are hallmark singular responses of non-Hermitian systems, with potential applications in sensing, wave control, and energy manipulation. Yet, realizing and independently tuning these states in a compact integrated platform remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate two-dimensional magnetic control of RLs and EPs in an on-chip magnon-phonon system based on a FeGaB-32 degree-YX-LiNbO3 heterostructure. The magnetic-field magnitude tunes the magnon-phonon detuning, driving a low-loss reflection zero across the real-frequency axis and producing two field-tunable RLs with near-vanishing reflection. A closed contour of the experimentally measured complex S11 around the reflection-zero singularity accumulates a -2pi phase winding. Independently, rotating the magnetic field tunes the magnon-phonon coupling strength, driving the intrinsic magnon-phonon eigenmode spectrum across an exceptional point, identified by the exchange between real-part and imaginary-part eigenvalue splitting. A unified one-port input-output model connects the measured complex S11 response to the field-driven dynamics of the reflection zeros and the angle-tuned intrinsic magnon-phonon eigenmodes. These results establish a magnetically programmable non-Hermitian magnon-phonon platform for integrated wave control and compact vector magnetic sensing.

AI.tldr: 该工作在FeGaB/32°YX-LiNbO3芯片化磁子-声子平台上，利用磁场强度调节失谐实现两个可调无反射态（RLs），利用磁场方向调节耦合强度跨越奇异点（EP），并用统一单端口输入-输出模型解释复杂S11响应。
AI.motivation: 无反射态（RLs）与奇异点（EPs）是非厄米系统的标志性奇异响应，在传感、波调控与能量操控中有应用潜力，但在紧凑集成平台上同时实现并独立调控二者仍具挑战。
AI.method: 采用FeGaB-32°YX-LiNbO3异质结构构建片上磁子-声子系统：磁场强度调控磁子-声子失谐，驱动低损耗反射零点沿实频轴移动；磁场旋转调控磁子-声子耦合强度，使本征模式谱跨越EP。建立统一单端口输入-输出模型，将测量的复S11响应与反射零点动力学及角度调谐本征模式相联系。
AI.result: 实现两个近零反射的场可调RLs；实验测得复S11绕反射零点奇点形成闭合围道并累积-2π相位缠绕；通过实部与虚部本征值劈裂的交换确认EP；单端口模型与实验S11及本征模式演化一致。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了磁可编程非厄米磁子-声子平台，可用于集成波调控与紧凑型矢量磁传感。

title: Andreev-Enhanced Conductance in a Bilayer Graphene Quantum Point Contact
summary: Quantum point contacts provide a platform for probing mode-dependent Andreev reflection. Here, we demonstrate Andreev-enhanced conductance in a gate-defined bilayer graphene quantum point contact coupled to a superconducting aluminum electrode. Electrostatic gating enables sequential mode occupation, verified by normal-state conductance quantization. In the superconducting state, the conductance is enhanced within the conductance plateaus, while the enhancement decreases between plateaus, consistent with the nonlinear transmission dependence of Andreev reflection. The enhancement yields effective transmission probabilities up to 0.9, and extends over a bias window of approximately 140 $μ$V, which we associate with a proximity-induced superconducting gap, close to the gap of the aluminum film. For in-plane fields, the enhancement persists up to the critical field, and the bias window follows the spectral gap predicted by Abrikosov-Gor'kov theory. In contrast, perpendicular fields suppress the enhancement approximately linearly from zero field, deviating from homogeneous pair breaking and indicative of flux penetration.

AI.tldr: 在双层石墨烯栅控量子点接触与铝超导电极耦合体系中观测到随导通电导平台模式变化的Andreev增强电导，验证了非线性透射依赖的Andreev反射。
AI.motivation: 量子点接触可用于探测与模式相关的Andreev反射，此前尚缺乏在可调控石墨烯量子点接触中系统性验证模式依赖Andreev增强的实验。
AI.method: 制备栅定义的双层石墨烯量子点接触并耦合Al超导电极；通过静电栅压实现模式的顺序占据（由正常态电导量子化验证）；在超导态下测量电导增强及偏压窗口，并在面内与垂直磁场下研究其演化。
AI.result: 超导态下电导在平台内增强、平台间减弱，符合Andreev反射的非线性透射依赖；有效透射率高达0.9，增强偏压窗口约140 μV，与近邻诱导超导能隙（接近Al膜能隙）相符。面内磁场中增强持续至临界场，偏压窗口遵循Abrikosov-Gor'kov理论预言；垂直磁场则从零场起近似线性抑制增强，偏离均匀配对破缺，指示磁通穿透。
AI.conclusion: 双层石墨烯量子点接触是研究模式分辨Andreev反射的可调平台，且各向异性磁场响应可用于区分均匀配对破缺与磁通穿透机制。

title: Generative Design and Graph Neural Network Screening of Novel Bimetallic Alloy Catalysts for the Hydrogen Evolution Reaction
summary: Identifying earth-abundant catalysts for the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) is a central challenge in scalable green hydrogen production. We present a computational pipeline that couples diffusion-based generative modelling, machine-learning force-field relaxation, and graph neural network (GNN) property prediction to discover bimetallic HER catalysts beyond the structures and stoichiometries covered by existing adsorption databases. A generative model (MatterGen) is fine-tuned on bulk alloy structures labelled with their minimum hydrogen adsorption energy and steered towards adsorption energies near zero. From the generated pool we retain the stable structures that are novel bimetallic alloys: binary compositions built from the training-set metals but at stoichiometries or structures absent from that database. Each candidate's low-index facets are ranked by a machine-learning-force-field (MatterSim) surface-energy screen, and only the most stable terminations are converted into explicit slab models with hydrogen adsorbed at all high-symmetry surface sites and relaxed with the same force field. Two GNN surrogates (MEGNet and ALIGNN), trained on a high-throughput density functional theory (DFT) dataset, then screen the resulting slab candidates. Because the two models encode the local environment through different inductive biases, we retain only the alloys on which both agree, reducing the influence of any single model. This consensus screening, combined with a MatterSim energy-difference triangulation, resulted in a shortlist of near-thermoneutral bimetallic candidates. Eight are validated with plane-wave DFT, and four of them, Pd5Au, Pt5Rh, Cu5Pt3, and Pd13Ru3, bind hydrogen within the thermoneutral window. All eight alloys are dynamically stable by phonon calculations. These four alloys are highlighted as DFT-validated bimetallic HER candidates for experimental follow-up.

AI.tldr: 提出耦合扩散生成模型、机器学习力场弛豫与图神经网络性质预测的计算流程，用于发现数据库外的新型双金属析氢反应催化剂，最终四个合金经DFT验证落在热中性窗口内。
AI.motivation: 寻找储量丰富的析氢反应(HER)催化剂是规模化绿氢生产的关键难题，而现有吸附数据库覆盖的结构与化学计量比有限，难以直接从中挖掘新催化剂。
AI.method: 用MatterGen在带最小氢吸附能标签的块体合金结构上微调，并向近零吸附能方向引导生成；筛出新颖且稳定的双金属合金，用MatterSim按表面能对低指数晶面排序，构建最稳定终止面的slab并在所有高对称位点吸附氢后弛豫；再用MEGNet与ALIGNN两个GNN代理模型共识筛选，结合MatterSim能量差三角验证得到短名单。
AI.result: 得到近热中性双金属候选短名单，其中8个经平面波DFT验证，Pd5Au、Pt5Rh、Cu5Pt3、Pd13Ru3四个在热中性窗口内结合氢，且8个合金均由声子计算证明动力学稳定。
AI.conclusion: 该多模型共识流程可有效发现数据库外的新型双金属HER催化剂，四个DFT验证合金被推荐用于后续实验验证。

title: Thermal conductivity of Lennard-Jones fluids from equilibrium thermodynamics
summary: We derive a general expression for the thermal conductivity of simple fluids within a thermodynamic transport theory (TTT) in which the Onsager coefficients of an interacting system are related to those of an ideal reference system through the ratio of the determinants of the Hessians of the relevant thermodynamic potential. The transported quantity is identified with an effective energy density proportional to the rms energy fluctuations of a small fluid cell. The result expresses the thermal conductivity as the product of its dilute-gas value and a function of equilibrium thermodynamic properties, namely the specific heats at constant density and at constant $ρT$ and the temperature derivative of the latter, with no adjustable parameters. For hard spheres, it reduces to a previously verified expression in terms of the thermodynamic factor. The theory is tested against molecular dynamics results for the Lennard-Jones (LJ) and the truncated and shifted Lennard-Jones (LJTS) fluids in the supercritical region, for densities up to $ρ^*=0.8$, using equations of state based on perturbation theory. For the LJTS fluid, the mean absolute percentage error is below 8\% for all the temperatures considered. For the LJ fluid, the predictions are compared with those of the revised Enskog theory for Mie fluids, using the same equation of state: TTT gives smaller errors at almost all temperatures, with a significant improvement at low temperatures, where the errors are reduced approximately by a factor between two and three.

AI.tldr: 在热力学输运理论（TTT）框架下导出了简单流体热导率的通用表达式：将输运量取为与局域涨落相关的有效能量密度，热导率等于稀薄气体值乘以由平衡热力学性质（等密度与等ρT比热及其温度导数）给出的因子，无自由参数；对硬球约化为已验证结果。对LJ与LJTS超临界流体（ρ*≤0.8）与MD对比，LJTS平均绝对误差<8%，LJ优于Mie体系的修正Enskog理论，低温区误差降低约2–3倍。
AI.motivation: 现有简单流体热导率理论（如Enskog修正理论）在低温、较高密度下误差偏大，且往往需要可调参数或缺乏与平衡热力学性质的清晰联系。作者希望建立一个无自由参数、以平衡热力学量表达的输运理论，用以改善Lennard-Jones类流体在超临界区的热导率预测，尤其是低温区域。
AI.method: 采用热力学输运理论（TTT）：通过相关热力学势Hessian行列式之比，把相互作用体系的Onsager系数与理想参考体系联系起来；将输运量取为与局域小体积元均方根能量涨落成正比的“有效能量密度”。由此把热导率写成稀薄气体值乘以一个仅依赖平衡热力学性质的函数——等密度比热、等ρT比热及后者对温度的导数，不含可调参数。对硬球情形该式退化为已有以热力学因子表示的形式。随后用基于微扰理论的状态方程，对LJ与截断平移LJ（LJTS）流体在超临界区、密度至ρ*=0.8进行数值评估，并与分子动力学数据比较；LJ还与该状态方程下Mie流体的修正Enskog理论预测对比。
AI.result: 对LJTS流体，所有考察温度下平均绝对百分误差均低于8%。对LJ流体，TTT在几乎所有温度下误差均小于Mie流体的修正Enskog理论，低温改进显著，误差约缩小到原来的1/3至1/2（即降低2–3倍）。
AI.conclusion: TTT给出一个仅依赖平衡热力学性质、无可调参数的简单流体热导率表达式，在超临界LJ与LJTS流体的分子动力学数据上总体精度良好（LJTS误差<8%），并在低温区明显优于修正Enskog理论，说明以热力学涨落定义有效输运能量密度是可行且有竞争力的路线；但其验证限于超临界、ρ*≤0.8，需进一步检验更宽状态范围。

title: Shock Loading Accesses Reaction Pathways beyond Accelerated Thermolysis
summary: Thermolysis and shock loading can produce similar major stable products in energetic materials, despite different chemical evolution and reaction pathways. Here, we develop EMFF-MACE, a reactive machine-learning potential for C/H/N/O energetic materials, enabling thermolysis simulations of 20 materials and shock simulations of 10 on a common potential energy surface. Comparisons at matched normalized reaction progress reveal divergent chemical states and local structural environments. Mean reaction-state similarity decreases from 94.0% at 20% progress to 25.9% at trajectory endpoints, while 47.1-92.6% of shock local environments lie outside corresponding material-specific thermolysis reference domains. Structural and reaction-network analyses reveal enhanced intermolecular reorganization and additional association and rearrangement branches under shock loading, despite partially shared early decomposition chemistry. These findings show that loading history influences the structural states and subsequent reaction pathways accessed during decomposition, rather than merely the rate of thermolysis.

AI.tldr: 提出EMFF-MACE反应性机器学习势，在统一势能面上模拟20种含能材料热解与10种冲击，发现冲击与热解仅在早期化学上相似，加载历史决定后续反应路径。
AI.motivation: 热解与冲击加载在含能材料中产生相似的主要稳定产物，但化学演化与反应路径不同，其根源机制尚不清楚；需要能在同一势能面上同时描述两类加载方式的方法。
AI.method: 开发EMFF-MACE——面向C/H/N/O含能材料的反应性机器学习势（基于MACE架构），实现20种材料热解模拟与10种材料冲击模拟共享同一势能面；在匹配的归一化反应进度下比较化学状态与局部结构环境，并进行结构分析与反应网络分析。
AI.result: 匹配反应进度下反应态相似度由20%进度时的94.0%降至轨迹终点时的25.9%；47.1%–92.6%的冲击局部环境落在对应材料热解参考域之外；冲击下分子间重组增强，并出现额外的缔合与重排反应分支。
AI.conclusion: 加载历史不仅改变热解速率，更影响分解过程中所达到的结构状态及后续可及的反应路径；尽管早期分解化学部分共享，热解与冲击在中后期显著分岔。

title: Tensor cluster expansion as an efficient surrogate for multi-ACE
summary: In this work, we generalize an on-lattice tensor cluster expansion (TCE) framework to an arbitrary correlation order. We show that these generalized tensor cluster expansion features span a subspace of MACE features, suggesting that TCE features can sufficiently pre-screen MACE features for chemical diversity in alloyed transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) monolayers. We show that, using maximum-entropy subset sampling, we can empirically recover chemical diversity from MACE features using a cheaper TCE representation. We then fine-tune a multi-ACE (MACE) potential with both subsets, and use this potential to predict temperature-dependent vibrational properties in alloyed TMD monolayers with varying chemical ordering. In our approach, TCE features can be used as cheap surrogate features for pre-screening chemically rich configurations using MACE features, allowing for the more efficient finetuning of atomic cluster expansion (ACE) potentials, thus achieving a tractable prediction of finite-temperature alloy thermodynamics on modest hardware.

AI.tldr: 该论文将晶格张量簇展开(TCE)推广到任意关联阶数，证明其特征张成MACE特征的一个子空间，并用最大熵子集采样以低成本的TCE表示筛出化学多样性构型，用于更高效地微调MACE势，从而在普通硬件上预测合金化TMD单层的有限温度振动性质与热力学。
AI.motivation: 合金化过渡金属硫族化合物(TMD)单层的有限温度热力学预测需要昂贵的原子簇展开/MACE势微调，尤其是在需要覆盖化学多样性构型时计算成本过高，缺乏廉价且可靠的构型预筛手段。
AI.method: 将on-lattice张量簇展开(TCE)推广至任意关联阶；理论上说明广义TCE特征构成MACE特征的子空间；采用最大熵子集采样，用廉价TCE特征从MACE特征空间中经验性地恢复化学多样性；随后用两部分子集微调多-ACE(MACE)势。
AI.result: 实验上能用更廉价的TCE表示从MACE特征中恢复化学多样性；用两类子集微调的MACE势可预测不同化学有序度下合金化TMD单层的温度依赖振动性质，且在普通硬件上即可完成有限温度合金热力学的可行预测。
AI.conclusion: TCE特征可作为廉价代理特征，用于基于MACE特征预筛化学丰富构型，使ACE势的微调更高效，从而实现低成本、可承受的有限温度合金热力学预测。

title: Solvable coupled cluster states in $d=\infty$ with prescribed momentum distribution
summary: Two of the most successful ideas in many-body theory, the exponential coupled cluster ansatz and DMFT, have to date developed separately. We establish a connection between them, by showing that the infinite dimensional limit of the hypercubic lattice allows the exact closed-form evaluation of static expectation values of coupled cluster wave functions, provided the cluster amplitudes admit a low-rank decomposition. As a result, evaluation errors -- a serious concern in conventional coupled cluster theory -- can be disentangled from limitations to expressivity of coupled cluster states. For this family of coupled cluster states, the cavity construction in $d\to\infty$ exactly reduces the environment of a lattice site to a Gaussian Grassmann kernel, and irreducible diagrams for one-body expectation values are found to be site-diagonal (in analogy to the DMFT self-energy). The resulting ``impurity problem" is an integral over a finite number of Grassmann variables rather than a dynamical quantum impurity problem, so that static observables derive exactly from a static self-consistency condition: a wave function counterpart of DMFT. For the simplest case of a cluster amplitude restricted to rank-one doubles, we obtain the momentum distribution in closed form. We show that any momentum distribution can be realized by a state that is the exact and unique ground state of an explicit parent Hamiltonian with a gapless single-particle tunnelling spectrum. By construction these coupled cluster states variationally recover low order perturbation theory for the Hubbard model. Their failure in the strong coupling regime near the Mott transition diagnoses a fundamental limitation of coupled cluster doubles. Intriguingly, our family of coupled cluster wave functions includes a gapless state with zero quasiparticle weight, with a momentum distribution that is completely smooth at the Fermi energy.

AI.tldr: 本文将耦合簇（CC）与动力学平均场理论（DMFT）联系起来：在超立方晶格 d→∞ 极限下，若簇振幅可低秩分解，则可对 CC 波函数的静态期望值作精确闭式求解，从而把"计算误差"与"表达力限制"区分开。
AI.motivation: 指数耦合簇拟设与 DMFT 是多体理论中最成功的两个思想，但此前一直各自独立发展，缺乏统一框架。
AI.method: 利用无限维极限下的空腔构造，证明晶格格点的环境精确约化为高斯 Grassmann 核，单体积分图是格点对角的（类比 DMFT 自能）；由此"杂质问题"变成有限个 Grassmann 变量的积分而非动力学量子杂质问题，静态可观测量由静态自洽条件精确给出，成为 DMFT 的波函数对偶。对秩一 doubles 情形给出动量分布的闭式解，并构造相应父哈密顿量。
AI.result: 动量分布可闭式求得；任意动量分布均可由某个显式父哈密顿量的唯一精确基态实现，且该哈密顿量具有无能隙单粒子隧穿谱。该 CC 态族在变分意义上重现 Hubbard 模型的低阶微扰理论，但在 Mott 转变附近的强耦合区失效，暴露出 CCD 的根本局限。此外该态族包含零准粒子权重的无能隙态，其动量分布在费米能处完全光滑。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了 CC 与 DMFT 的桥梁，提供了一个可解析处理的 CC 态族，可用来诊断耦合簇理论内在的表达力局限，并揭示了无能隙但无准粒子（非费米液体式）波函数的可能性。

title: Relaxation speed in quenched-random force fields
summary: Disorder is commonly expected to slow down relaxation, as in glasses and disordered magnets. Here we show that this need not be the case in general, by analysing the asymptotic relaxation rate of a Brownian particle in a harmonic background potential and a quenched-random Gaussian force field with conservative and non-conservative components. Combining weak-disorder perturbation theory, random-matrix theory, and numerical solutions of the Fokker-Planck equation, we show that the outcome depends on the geometry of the background and on the properties of the random forces. We identify two distinct mechanisms that shape the relaxation speed: an effective stiffening of the background by the disorder, as previously reported in one dimension, and interactions (repulsive and attractive) between the levels of the Fokker-Planck operator. Through level attraction, a common feature of non-Hermitian operators, non-conservative driving forces pull the slowest mode towards faster ones, which facilitates faster relaxation. In anisotropic backgrounds, both effects occur at second order in the disorder strength, enabling either slower or faster relaxation. In isotropic backgrounds, level interactions dominate and the disorder affects the degenerate slowest mode already at first order. The shift is then given by the left-most eigenvalue of a Gaussian random matrix and relaxation is generically slowed down. In backgrounds whose anisotropy is comparable to the disorder strength, level attraction is most effective by merging the slowest mode with its neighbour into an oscillating complex-conjugate pair. In this case, relaxation becomes faster on average once the random forces are sufficiently non-conservative. Our results draw a nuanced picture of how disorder affects the asymptotic relaxation speed in complex systems and uncover general mechanisms that are likely to apply beyond the current setting.

AI.tldr: 本文结合微扰论、随机矩阵理论与Fokker-Planck方程数值解，揭示淬火无序可加速或减慢布朗粒子在高斯随机力场中的渐近弛豫，机制包括背景“变硬”与Fokker-Planck算子能级间的吸引/排斥，其中非保守力导致的能级吸引可加快弛豫。
AI.motivation: 通常认为无序会减慢弛豫（如玻璃、无序磁体），但这一直觉是否普遍成立尚不清楚；作者希望弄清楚背景势与随机力场的几何、保守/非保守成分如何共同决定无序对渐近弛豫速率的影响。
AI.method: 研究谐振背景势加淬火高斯随机力场（含保守与非保守成分）中布朗粒子的渐近弛豫速率；综合使用弱无序微扰论、随机矩阵理论以及Fokker-Planck方程的数值求解。
AI.result: 识别出两种机制：无序使背景有效变硬（一维已有报道），以及Fokker-Planck算子能级间的排斥/吸引相互作用。各向异性背景下两者均在无序强度二阶出现，可致更快或更慢；各向同性背景下能级相互作用主导，简并最慢模在一阶即移动，移动量由高斯随机矩阵最左特征值给出，弛豫普遍变慢；各向异性与无序强度可比时，能级吸引将最慢模与其邻居合并为复共轭振荡对，随机力足够非保守时平均弛豫变快。
AI.conclusion: 无序对渐近弛豫速度的影响取决于背景几何与随机力性质，既可减慢也可加快；能级吸引作为非厄米算子的普遍特征提供了加速机制，这些机理可能推广到当前设定之外的复杂系统。

title: Anomalies of TQFTs coupled to parameter spaces and constraints on ground-state degeneracies
summary: Anomalies of global symmetries can arise in long-range entangled quantum many-body systems and provide useful constraints on their dynamics. In this paper, we study anomalies of $d$-dimensional topological quantum field theories (TQFTs) coupled to parameter spaces and their implications for ground-state degeneracies. Specifically, we formulate anomalies as obstructions to constructing parametrized families of TQFTs. We discuss how the classification of these anomalies depends on the choice of topology on the universal $\mathrm{U}(1)$ $(d-1)$-form symmetry. In this framework, we use the projective ground-state bundle obtained by compactifying the TQFT on a spatial manifold to derive a general constraint relating its ground-state degeneracy $N$ to its torsion anomaly $ω$, expressed as $N\int_Wω\in\mathbb{Z}$ for bundles $W$ of spatial manifolds over closed surfaces. We apply this constraint to ground-state degeneracies of (2+1)-dimensional TQFTs with framing and 1-form symmetry anomalies and to obstructions to symmetry-preserving TQFTs. We also discuss implications for bordism generators and propose a conjecture on anomaly detection by manifolds fibered over surfaces.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究d维拓扑量子场论(TQFT)耦合到参数空间时全局对称性反常的分类，将其表述为构造参数化TQFT族的障碍，并导出基态简并度N与挠反常ω之间的约束 N∫_W ω ∈ ℤ。
AI.motivation: 长程纠缠量子多体系统中全局对称性反常可约束其动力学，但TQFT耦合参数空间时的反常及其对基态简并度的影响尚需系统刻画。
AI.method: 将反常定义为构造参数化TQFT族的障碍；讨论反常分类对万有U(1) (d-1)-形式对称所取拓扑的依赖性；通过将TQFT在空间流形上紧化得到投影基态丛，由此推导约束关系。
AI.result: 证明对闭曲面上的空间流形丛W，基态简并度N与挠反常ω满足 N∫_W ω ∈ ℤ；该约束应用于带framing及1-形式对称反常的(2+1)维TQFT的基态简并度，并给出保持对称性TQFT的存在性障碍。
AI.conclusion: 给出协边生成元方面的推论，并提出关于"以纤维化于曲面的流形探测反常"的猜想。

title: Generation and spectroscopic characterization of continuous-wave 148.4-nm light in strontium tetraborate
summary: Continuous-wave (CW) radiation at 148.4~nm is required to drive the $^{229}$Th isomeric transition of a solid-state nuclear clock, and frequency doubling of 296.8-nm light is its most direct source. We generate CW 148.4-nm light by random quasi-phase matching in strontium tetraborate and characterize it with a compact prism spectrometer built for the purpose. The spectrometer separates the harmonic from the pump on a CaF$_2$ prism, reads the wavelength from the rotation angle of a solar-blind photomultiplier, resolves the two lines with $δλ\approx 0.6~nm$, and yields an absolute power calibration. At room temperature the source delivers $1.9~nW$ at 148.4~nm, rising to 5.7 nW at the optimum crystal temperature. The conversion efficiency is also strongly structured in temperature: between 30 degree and 50 degree it shows several pronounced maxima, with neighbouring extrema only a few degrees apart, so that a small temperature excursion moves the output from a maximum to a minimum. These results provide practical guidance for optimizing and stabilizing 148.4-nm sources for solid-state $^{229}$Th nuclear clocks.

AI.tldr: 通过四硼酸锶中的随机准相位匹配产生148.4 nm连续波激光，并用自制棱镜光谱仪表征，在最佳晶体温度下获得5.7 nW输出，为固态²²⁹Th核钟光源提供优化与稳频指导。
AI.motivation: 固态²²⁹Th核钟的同质异能跃迁需要148.4 nm连续波辐射，而296.8 nm倍频是最直接的产生途径，因此需要实用化的148.4 nm光源及其表征与优化手段。
AI.method: 在四硼酸锶晶体中利用随机准相位匹配产生148.4 nm连续光，并搭建紧凑型CaF₂棱镜光谱仪：用棱镜分离谐波与泵浦，由日盲光电倍增管旋转角读取波长，实现双线分辨（δλ≈0.6 nm）与绝对功率标定；同时测量输出随晶体温度的变化。
AI.result: 室温下输出1.9 nW，最佳晶体温度下达5.7 nW；转换效率随温度呈强烈结构，30–50 °C间出现多个显著极大值，相邻极值仅相差数度，微小温度波动即可使输出在极大与极小之间变化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了148.4 nm光源的可实现方案与温度特性数据，为固态²²⁹Th核钟光源的优化与温度稳定化提供了实用依据。

title: Current-driven transient dynamics of magnetic-octupole domain walls in noncollinear antiferromagnets
summary: Current-driven magnetic-octupole domain walls in noncollinear antiferromagnets are promising for fast spintronic devices, yet their transient dynamics are not yet fully understood. Here, we investigate spin-orbit-torque-driven domain-wall motion in Mn$_\text{3}$Sn using a multipole micromagnetic framework. The three symmetry-related 60° walls exhibit equivalent current-driven dynamics, unlike their field-driven motion. For a representative 60° wall, the post-pulse motion is governed by relaxation of the current-induced rotation of the surrounding octupole domains, with a characteristic time of approximately 33 ps quantitatively captured by a uniform-domain analytic model. By resolving spatially nonuniform texture dynamics beyond this analytic description, the simulations further reveal an additional slow relaxation in a composite 180° wall associated with the relative motion of its constituent walls. The post-pulse response also varies systematically with the exchange stiffness and magnetic anisotropies. These results identify distinct domain and internal-coordinate relaxation channels and establish the intrinsic time scales governing pulse-controlled positioning of magnetic-octupole domain walls in antiferromagnetic spintronic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文用多极微磁框架研究Mn3Sn中自旋轨道矩驱动的磁八极畴壁瞬态动力学，发现三种60°畴壁电流驱动行为等效，脉冲后运动由约33 ps的八极畴旋转弛豫主导，并揭示复合180°畴壁的额外慢弛豫通道。
AI.motivation: 电流驱动的非共线反铁磁体磁八极畴壁有望用于高速自旋电子器件，但其瞬态动力学（尤其脉冲后响应）尚未被充分理解。
AI.method: 采用多极微磁框架模拟Mn3Sn中自旋轨道矩驱动的畴壁运动，结合均匀畴解析模型与空间非均匀织构动力学模拟，系统考察交换刚度和磁各向异性的影响。
AI.result: 三种对称相关的60°畴壁电流驱动动力学等效（区别于场驱动）；代表性60°畴壁脉冲后运动由周围八极畴电流诱导旋转的弛豫主导，特征时间约33 ps，与解析模型定量吻合；复合180°畴壁存在由组成畴壁相对运动引起的额外慢弛豫；脉冲后响应随交换刚度和各向异性系统变化。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别出不同的畴与内坐标弛豫通道，确立了决定反铁磁自旋电子器件中磁八极畴壁脉冲控制定位的本征时间尺度。

title: Charge Pumping Leptogenesis from the Symmetric Mass Generation Phase on a Four-Leg Ladder Lattice
summary: Quantized charge pumping in quantum Hall systems is a bulk topological property, typically manifesting on gapless boundaries as spectral flow through chiral edge modes upon flux insertion. When the boundary is anomaly-free, it can be symmetrically gapped by symmetric mass generation (SMG) interactions. However, the effects on quantized charge pumping at an interacting gapped boundary are unclear. We address this using density-matrix renormalization group simulations of a four-leg ladder quasi-(2+1)d realization of the (1+1)d 3-4-5-0 lattice chiral fermion model with six-fermion interactions at one edge. We find gapless modes near the interacting edge for both weak and strong couplings, but the edge can be in a fully gapped SMG phase at intermediate coupling. We also identify spontaneous breaking of the model's $\mathbb{Z}_2$ symmetry above a critical interaction strength. Across all three boundary phases, we find quantized charge pumping with the same pumped charge per flux quantum. The spatial distribution of the pumped charge varies between phases. Besides charge pumping, we study how a single injected fermion propagates under open boundary conditions. In the SMG phase, an interaction-induced flavor-mixing current develops at the endpoints of the gapped edge, which is absent in the weak- and strong-coupling limits. This current reveals a charge-redistribution mechanism unique to the SMG phase. Additionally, we propose an analogy between charge pumping in this model and a topological leptogenesis scenario in the (3+1)d Standard Model. The anomaly-free chiral U(1) symmetries of the 3-4-5-0 model play a role analogous to the baryon-minus-lepton symmetry of the Standard Model. In both settings, charge pumping can be associated with a continuous deformation along a classically defined but quantum-anomalous direction, while a discrete subgroup remains an exact quantum symmetry.
