title: Quantum 3xplorer: AI-Native Engine for Next-Generation Quantum Materials Modeling
summary: Quantum-mechanical approaches, such as density functional theory (DFT), underpin much of modern computational materials science and are the primary source of data for AI-driven discovery. Yet the established electronic-structure codes today represent decades-old software architectures, making new physical models slow and costly to implement, validate, and deploy on emerging hardware. We present Quantum 3xplorer (Q3, pronounced "Quantum Explorer"), an AI-native quantum simulation engine written from scratch by AI coding agents under the direction and supervision of domain scientists. As a first and demanding validation case, we implement plane-wave pseudopotential DFT end to end: norm-conserving, ultrasoft, and projector-augmented-wave formalisms, spin polarization, DFT+U, and dispersion corrections, together with forces, stresses, structural relaxation, and electronic-structure analysis. Q3 reproduces established reference implementations, runs faster on a single core in representative benchmarks, and scales across GPU-accelerated supercomputers. It was developed in weeks rather than years. Its layered, physics-first architecture separates abstract quantum-mechanical concepts from their numerical representations, making its framework extendable beyond plane waves to other basis sets and levels of theory. Its inputs and outputs follow structured, schema-validated data standards, making every result AI-ready. Q3 is open source under Apache 2.0 and built to be reused, extended, and improved by the research community. Q3 points to a paradigm shift in how computational quantum science is done. Scientists define the physics, formulate the models, and set the criteria for validation; AI agents write, test, and optimize the code. The decades-long path from a new theory to a trusted, high-performance implementation can thus collapse to days, significantly accelerating scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: AI编码代理在科学家监督下从零构建出量子模拟引擎Quantum 3xplorer（Q3），以平面波赝势DFT为首个验证案例，结果与参考实现一致、单核更快、可GPU超算扩展，开发周期从数年缩短为数周。
AI.motivation: 现有DFT等电子结构代码是数十年前的软件架构，导致新物理模型实现、验证、部署到新硬件都缓慢昂贵，也制约了AI驱动材料发现所需的数据生产。
AI.method: 由领域科学家设定物理定义与验证标准，AI coding agents编写、测试并优化代码，从零构建AI-native量子模拟引擎Q3；首个案例端到端实现平面波赝势DFT（模守恒、超软、PAW、自旋极化、DFT+U、色散修正，及力、应力、结构弛豫与电子结构分析）；采用分层、物理优先架构，将抽象量子力学概念与数值表示分离，并用结构化schema校验的输入输出格式。
AI.result: Q3复现了既有参考实现的结果，在代表性基准上单核速度更快，并可跨GPU加速超算扩展；开发仅用数周而非数年；架构可扩展到其他基组与理论层级，输出AI-ready；以Apache 2.0开源。
AI.conclusion: Q3表明计算量子科学范式可转变：科学家定义物理与验证标准，AI代理编写和优化代码，使从新理论到可信高性能实现的过程从数十年缩短到数天，从而显著加速科学发现。

title: Observation of light-induced Haldane gap in graphene
comment: This manuscript was submitted and sent out for review on 2026/09/24
summary: Symmetry and topology, encoded in electronic wavefunctions, play a central role in the electronic properties and emergent phenomena of quantum materials. While these properties are conventionally determined by the equilibrium Hamiltonian, strong optical fields offer a fundamentally different route by reshaping the Hamiltonian on ultrafast timescales, turning symmetry and topology into dynamically controllable degrees of freedom. Graphene provides a paradigmatic platform for realizing this concept, where circularly polarized light has long been predicted to dynamically break time-reversal symmetry (TRS) and open a topologically nontrivial gap at the Dirac point. Despite extensive experimental efforts, direct observation of this Dirac gap-the defining spectroscopic signature of the dynamical TRS-breaking induced topological phase-has remained missing. Here we directly observe this light-induced Dirac gap in monolayer graphene. Time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy reveals that the gap emerges simultaneously with the optical field and exclusively under circularly polarized driving, directly linking its opening to dynamical TRS breaking. Together with Floquet theory, we identify the gap with a light-induced Haldane mass and reveal the associated nontrivial Floquet Berry curvature and Chern topology. By demonstrating dynamical TRS breaking in a prototypical non-magnetic material, our results establish optical driving as a route to ultrafast engineering of symmetry and topology, opening opportunities for dynamically tunable quantum matter beyond equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 利用时间分辨与角分辨光电子能谱首次直接观测到单层石墨烯在圆偏振光驱动下于狄拉克点打开的能隙，证实了光致时间反演对称性破缺及Floquet拓扑相。
AI.motivation: 对称性与拓扑决定量子材料性质，通常由平衡哈密顿量决定。理论上预言圆偏振光可在石墨烯中动态破坏时间反演对称性并在狄拉克点打开拓扑非平庸能隙，但这一能隙的直接实验观测长期缺失。
AI.method: 采用时间分辨与角分辨光电子能谱（tr-ARPES），在飞秒光场驱动下测量单层石墨烯的电子结构，并结合Floquet理论分析。
AI.result: 能隙与光场同步出现，且仅在圆偏振驱动下产生，将其打开直接归因于动态时间反演对称性破缺；结合Floquet理论，将其识别为光致Haldane质量，并揭示对应的非平庸Floquet贝里曲率与陈数拓扑。
AI.conclusion: 在非磁性原型材料中展示了动态时间反演对称性破缺，确立光驱动作为对称性与拓扑超快调控的途径，为超越平衡态的动力学可调量子物质开辟新机遇。

title: Resolving the spinon hierarchy of the Heisenberg antiferromagnet
summary: A local spin fluctuation in the spin-$\tfrac12$ Heisenberg antiferromagnet creates an even number of fractional spinon excitations. We resolve its zero-temperature dynamical structure factor through six spinons directly in the thermodynamic limit. Beyond the established two-spinon contribution of $72.89\%$, the four-spinon response gives approximately $21.90\%$ of the integrated intensity and six spinons contribute a further $4.3\%$, bringing the response to about $99\%$ of both the intensity and first-frequency-moment sum rules. We derive momentum-independent first-moment fractions in the calculated sectors and a general upper-edge law $S_n\sim A_n(k)(ω_{n,u}-ω)^{(n^2-3)/2}$ for every even $n$ at nonzero momentum. The rapid growth of the edge exponent explains why the expanding multiparticle bandwidth carries very little high-energy weight, while higher sectors remain appreciable within the lower-sector continua.

AI.tldr: 在热力学极限下直接计算了spin-1/2海森堡反铁磁体的零温动态结构因子，首次解析到六自旋子，发现两、四、六自旋子分别贡献约72.89%、21.90%和4.3%的积分强度，总计约99%。
AI.motivation: 局域自旋涨落会产生偶数个分数自旋子激发（spinon），但以往只建立了两自旋子图像（约占72.89%），更高阶多粒子部分对谱重的实际贡献尚不清楚，需定量厘清。
AI.method: 在海森堡反铁磁体spin-1/2模型中，于热力学极限下直接求解零温动态结构因子的多自旋子（两、四、六自旋子）贡献，并检验强度和第一频率矩求和规则；推导与动量无关的第一矩分数及任意偶数n的上边界律 S_n∼A_n(k)(ω_{n,u}−ω)^{(n²−3)/2}。
AI.result: 四自旋子贡献约21.90%积分强度，六自旋子再贡献4.3%，使总响应约达强度和第一频率矩求和规则的99%；得到与动量无关的第一矩分数；上边界幂指数随n快速增大，说明扩展的多粒子带宽携带的高能权重很小，而更高阶扇区在低阶连续谱内仍不可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 多自旋子（四、六）贡献显著、不可忽略，能基本满足求和规则；幂指数快速增长解释了高能权重稀薄现象，为分数化激发的多粒子谱提供定量图像。

title: Characterization of Phase Transitions with the Annealed Importance Sampling Algorithm
summary: We We explore the use of the Annealed Importance Sampling (AIS) algorithm as a numerical tool to study phase transitions and critical phenomena. By mapping physical systems such as Ising and spin-glass models directly onto Restricted Boltzmann Machines (RBMs), and extending the analysis to both synthetic and trained architectures, we use a unified RBM framework to compare the performance of AIS against standard Monte Carlo methods in regimes characterized by strong fluctuations and complex energy landscapes. The unified RBM formulation allows for massively parallel sampling, offering a scalable and precise alternative to traditional Monte Carlo methods. Building on a simple, heuristic mean-field AIS initialization derived from the weights of the network, the proposed scheme enhances sampling efficiency and accuracy across all systems considered, proving its effectiveness as a tool to detect and characterize phase transitions in discrete spin and spin-like systems. Our results show that a properly initialized AIS reliably estimates thermodynamic observables, including the partition function and magnetization, while accurately detecting both paramagnetic-ferromagnetic and paramagnetic-spin-glass phase transitions across various system sizes.

AI.tldr: 论文将Ising、自旋玻璃等物理系统映射到受限玻尔兹曼机（RBM）上，用退火重要性采样（AIS）结合基于网络权重的平均场初始化来研究相变，相比传统蒙特卡洛方法更高效、可大规模并行，且能准确估计配分函数、磁化强度并识别铁磁与自旋玻璃相变。
AI.motivation: 物理系统在强涨落与复杂能量景观区域，传统蒙特卡洛方法存在采样效率低、难以并行等问题；作者希望探索AIS作为研究相变与临界现象的数值工具，并借助RBM统一框架进行比较。
AI.method: 将Ising模型与自旋玻璃模型直接映射为RBM，并扩展到合成与已训练的RBM架构；提出一种从网络权重导出的、简单的启发式平均场AIS初始化方案；在该统一RBM框架下将AIS与标准蒙特卡洛方法进行对比，实现高度并行的采样。
AI.result: 正确初始化的AIS能可靠估计配分函数、磁化强度等热力学可观测量，并在多种系统尺寸下准确检测顺磁—铁磁相变和顺磁—自旋玻璃相变；平均场初始化在各系统上均提升了采样效率与精度。
AI.conclusion: AIS配合平均场初始化可作为检测和刻画离散自旋及类自旋系统相变的有效工具，RBM统一框架提供了可扩展、精确且可大规模并行的传统蒙特卡洛替代方案。

title: A variational phase-field theory of cohesive fracture at finite deformation
summary: This paper formulates a kinematically and variationally consistent phase-field theory for cohesive fracture at finite deformation. The theory introduces an independent compliance-damage field, which accommodates both diffuse distributions and singular concentrations. The phase-field is thereby freed from the dual burden of describing crack geometry and material degradation. A rank-one additive split of the deformation gradient makes separation explicit through independent crack-strain and reference-normal fields. All fields are governed by a single principle of minimum potential energy, which consistently couples nonlinear bulk deformation, crack separation, and crack-plane rotation. One-dimensional energy comparisons show that minimization favors Dirac-type concentration of compliance damage and crack strain. Strong displacement discontinuities thus emerge naturally at a finite phase-field length without being prescribed a priori, while the phase-field remains continuous. The concentrated energy recovers the exact bulk--interface structure of a sharp-crack cohesive zone model. General objective hyperelastic bulk potentials and admissible mixed-mode cohesive laws can therefore be prescribed independently, with the nominal traction--separation law unaffected by the bulk law or phase-field length. Diffuse damage can coexist with concentrated cracks, retaining deformation modes for bulk-energy relaxation during nucleation. Two- and three-dimensional examples validate the theory across large stretches, finite rotations, and complex crack paths. Notably, the computed near-tip Cauchy stress closely matches the analytical 1/r crack-tip asymptotic solution of Long et al. (2011) outside the cohesive zone.

AI.tldr: 提出一种运动学与变分一致的有限变形内聚断裂相场理论，引入独立柔度-损伤场与变形梯度秩一加性分解，使强位移间断在有限相场长度下自然涌现，同时解耦体相超弹响应与内聚牵引-分离律。
AI.motivation: 传统相场断裂中相场同时承担"描述裂纹几何"与"材料退化"双重职责，导致相场长度与内聚律耦合、牵引-分离律受体相本构和长度尺度影响，且难以在有限长度下重现锐裂纹的强位移间断与体-界面结构。
AI.method: 引入独立柔度-损伤场（可扩散亦可奇异集中），用变形梯度的秩一加性分解显式表达裂纹应变与参考法向；全部场由单一最小势能原理控制，一致耦合非线性体相变形、裂纹张开与裂纹面转动；通过一维能量比较论证极小化倾向于Dirac型集中。
AI.result: 强位移间断在有限相场长度下无需先验假定即自然出现而相场保持连续；集中能量恢复锐裂纹内聚区的精确体-界面结构；标称牵引-分离律不受体相律与相场长度影响；扩散损伤可与集中裂纹共存；二维/三维算例验证大拉伸、有限转动与复杂裂纹路径，且近尖端Cauchy应力在内聚区外与Long等(2011)的1/r渐近解吻合。
AI.conclusion: 该理论将裂纹几何与材料退化解耦，实现相场与锐裂纹内聚模型的统一与一致变分表述，可独立指定客观超弹体相势与混合模式内聚律，为有限变形内聚断裂提供了可验证的通用框架。

title: Electron Scattering with ASTRA: Helium and Molecular Hydrogen
summary: We present an implementation of electron-impact scattering in ASTRA, a close-coupling method based on transition density matrices previously applied to molecular photoionization. The scattering states are obtained with a pole-free Galerkin method with variational surface matching, which yields the scattering matrix and the channel-resolved amplitudes for elastic and electronically inelastic integral cross sections and molecular-frame differential cross sections. For helium, ASTRA reproduces elastic and inelastic cross sections over a broad energy range, resolves the He$^-$(1s2s$^2$ $^2$S$^e$) Feshbach resonance in both energy and angle, and captures the principal interference structures in the n=2 excitation angular distributions, in selected channels matching measured differential-cross-section ratios more closely than available benchmark calculations. For molecular hydrogen, target polarization and interchannel coupling are represented through additional close-coupling channels, without a fitted polarization potential or a separately constructed (N+1)-electron correlation space. Compared with the restricted-channel description, the expanded calculations substantially improve agreement with UKRmol+ for elastic and inelastic cross sections. We further report fully orientation-resolved three-dimensional molecular-frame angular distributions for state-resolved electron-impact excitation. These reveal pronounced stereodynamic effects that vanish upon orientational averaging: at 15 eV, excitation of the b$^3Σ_u^+$ state is more than eight times stronger for incident momentum parallel rather than perpendicular to the molecular axis. These results connect conventional scattering benchmarks with orientation-resolved collision dynamics and open the way to larger molecular targets.

AI.tldr: 将基于跃迁密度矩阵的紧耦合方法 ASTRA 扩展到电子碰撞散射，采用无极点 Galerkin 变分方法求解散射态，在 He 和 H2 上验证了弹性/非弹性截面与角度分布，并首次给出全取向分辨的三维分子框架角分布。
AI.motivation: 此前 ASTRA 仅用于分子光电离，需要检验其能否统一处理电子-分子碰撞；同时希望在不引入拟合极化势或单独 (N+1) 电子相关空间的前提下描述靶极化和通道间耦合，并把传统散射基准与取向分辨碰撞动力学联系起来。
AI.method: 在 ASTRA 紧耦合框架中实现电子碰撞散射；用无极点 Galerkin 方法结合变分表面匹配获得散射态，得到散射矩阵及各通道的弹性和电子非弹性积分截面、分子框架微分截面；对 H2 通过增加紧耦合通道表示靶极化和通道间耦合。
AI.result: He：宽能区弹性/非弹性截面复现，能量和角度上重现 He^-(1s2s^2 ^2S^e) Feshbach 共振，捕捉 n=2 激发角分布的干涉结构，部分通道与实验微分截面比值的吻合优于现有基准计算；H2：扩展通道后与 UKRmol+ 的弹性/非弹性截面一致性显著提升；发现强立体动力学效应，15 eV 下 b^3Σ_u^+ 态激发在入射动量平行分子轴时比垂直时强 8 倍以上，且取向平均后消失。
AI.conclusion: ASTRA 可作为贯通光电离与电子碰撞的统一紧耦合工具，无需拟合极化势即可描述分子靶极化与通道耦合；取向分辨结果连接传统散射基准与取向分辨碰撞动力学，并为更大分子靶奠定基础。

title: Physical Mechanisms of Light-Induced Molecular Fragmentation in the Long-Wavelength Regime
summary: Strong near-infrared (NIR) laser fields ionize polyatomic molecules through tunneling and multiphoton processes, while subsequent molecular fragmentation can be driven by electron rescattering and field-induced nonadiabatic excitation of the molecular ion. How these competing mechanisms deposit energy into molecular ions and determine fragmentation branching remains unresolved. By combining wavelength- and ellipticity-dependent intensity-difference mass spectrometry of methanol with time-dependent Schrödinger equation (TDSE) and semiclassical Monte Carlo simulations, we demonstrate that, in the tunneling-to-intermediate regime ($γ\lesssim 1$), molecular fragmentation is governed by the interplay of electron recollision and field-driven nonadiabatic excitation, revealing competing physical mechanisms relevant to polyatomic molecules more broadly. Ellipticity-dependent measurements demonstrate that these mechanisms can be experimentally distinguished for individual cationic fragments. Channels requiring high internal energies exhibit the strong ellipticity-dependent suppression characteristic of rescattering-driven processes, while lower-energy channels are comparatively less sensitive. Although small-fragment yields decrease substantially with increasing wavelength, their relative distributions remain largely unchanged, indicating that the underlying fragmentation pathways are preserved and that the suppression primarily reflects reduced probabilities of electron recollision and nonadiabatic excitations at longer wavelengths.

AI.tldr: 该文以甲醇为对象，结合波长与椭偏度依赖的强度差质谱与TDSE/半经典蒙特卡洛模拟，揭示隧穿—中间区（γ≲1）多原子分子碎裂由电子再碰撞与场致非绝热激发共同主导，并可通过椭偏度实验区分不同阳离子通道。
AI.motivation: 强近红外场电离多原子分子后，分子离子碎裂的能量沉积究竟由电子再碰撞还是场致非绝热激发主导、二者如何决定碎裂分支，此前尚未澄清。
AI.method: 对甲醇开展波长与椭偏度依赖的强度差质谱测量，并与含时薛定谔方程（TDSE）及半经典蒙特卡洛模拟相结合进行对照分析。
AI.result: 椭偏度依赖测量可实验区分各阳离子碎裂通道：需高内能的通道表现出再散射过程特有的强椭偏抑制，低能通道敏感性较弱；波长增加时小碎片产率显著下降，但相对分布基本不变。
AI.conclusion: 在隧穿—中间区分子碎裂由电子再碰撞与场致非绝热激发的竞争共同支配；长波长下产率下降主要源于再碰撞与非绝热激发概率降低，而碎裂路径本身保持不变。

title: Atomistic Emergence of Vibrational Polariton Condensation
summary: Nonequilibrium polariton condensation is a macroscopic quantum phenomenon in which overwhelming population accumulation is observed at the band edge of the lower polariton (LP) dispersion curve under incoherent material pumping. As a promising route toward nonequilibrium Bose--Einstein condensates, its description, however, remains predominantly limited to models with phenomenological material parameters. Herein, a fully atomistic description of vibrational polariton condensation is developed by employing mesoscale cavity molecular dynamics simulations, a method which self-consistently propagates classical electromagnetic dynamics coupled to realistic molecules in a multimode Fabry--Pérot cavity. Under continuous-wave pumping, a lower polariton condensate forms when the infrared cavity is coupled to harmonic, homogeneously broadened molecular vibrations, such as the bending modes of liquid CO2 and CS2, whereas anharmonic stretching modes and liquids with fast intramolecular relaxation hardly condense. The role of libration-bending coupling for facilitating the LP condensation is further discussed. GPU-accelerated mesoscale simulations involving approximately 50 million atoms additionally provide direct two-dimensional real-space imaging of fluid-like polariton patterns during the condensation formation. Overall, this study provides key design insights into vibrational polariton condensation as a novel approach for controlling liquid-phase chemistry.

AI.tldr: 该文用介观腔分子动力学（全原子）模拟，自洽耦合经典电磁场与多模法布里-珀罗腔中的真实分子，首次给出振动极化激元凝聚的全原子图像。
AI.motivation: 非平衡极化激元凝聚（低极化激元色散带边粒子大量累积）的描述长期局限于唯象材料参数模型，缺乏从真实分子结构出发的理论刻画，限制了对振动极化激元凝聚机制与液相化学调控设计的理解。
AI.method: 采用GPU加速的介观腔分子动力学模拟，自洽传播经典电磁动力学与约5000万原子的真实分子体系，在连续波泵浦下研究多模Fabry–Pérot腔中红外振动与腔模耦合的凝聚行为，并对比谐性/非谐性振动模式及不同分子内弛豫快慢的液体。
AI.result: 当红外腔耦合谐性、均匀展宽的分子振动（如液态CO2和CS2的弯曲模）时形成低极化激元凝聚；非谐性伸缩模及分子内弛豫快的液体几乎不凝聚；并讨论了转动-弯曲耦合对促进LP凝聚的作用，同时获得凝聚形成过程中流体状极化激元图案的二维实空间成像。
AI.conclusion: 为振动极化激元凝聚提供了关键设计准则，表明其可作为控制液相化学的新途径。

title: Streptavidin-Biotin Binding is Intrinsically Non-Cooperative, but Experimental Artefacts Can Induce Apparent Positive Cooperativity
summary: The biotin-streptavidin interaction is a key component of nanobiotechnology, yet the nature of its cooperativity remains a debated question. Here, we introduce a label-free spectroscopy approach based on confocal UV autofluorescence microscopy to probe the binding cooperativity of this high-affinity system. By leveraging the intrinsic autofluorescence of tryptophan residues, we avoid artefacts associated with extrinsic fluorescent labels, enabling precise measurements of fully biotin-saturated streptavidin across a wide range of molar ratios. Our experimental results, supported by Monte Carlo simulations, provide conclusive evidence for the absence of cooperativity. However, we show that false signs of apparent positive cooperativity can emerge from local concentration inhomogeneities occurring when rapid reaction kinetics outpace mixing. By establishing the non-cooperative nature of biotin-streptavidin binding and identifying the key conditions to avoid cooperativity artefacts, these insights resolve a longstanding debate and offer critical implications for streptavidin-based biotechnological applications.

AI.tldr: 本文用共聚焦紫外自发荧光显微光谱（无需外源标记）结合蒙特卡洛模拟，证明生物素-链霉亲和素结合无协同性，并揭示表观正协同性来自快速动力学下的局部浓度不均一（混合不足）造成的假象。
AI.motivation: 生物素-链霉亲和素相互作用是纳米生物技术的关键基础，但其是否具有协同性长期存在争议；同时外源荧光标记可能引入伪影，需发展无标记测量手段。
AI.method: 提出基于共聚焦紫外自发荧光显微镜的无标记光谱方法，利用色氨酸残基的内源自发荧光，避免外源荧光标签伪影；在宽摩尔比范围内测量被生物素完全饱和的链霉亲和素，并用蒙特卡洛模拟加以验证。
AI.result: 实验与模拟一致表明该体系不存在协同性；但在快速反应动力学快于混合速度时，局部浓度不均一会导致表观正协同性的假信号。
AI.conclusion: 确证生物素-链霉亲和素结合为非协同性，并指出避免协同性伪影的关键实验条件，从而解决长期争论，对基于链霉亲和素的生物技术应用具有重要指导意义。

title: A Hybrid Message-Passing and Electric-Field Representation for Electrostatic QM/MM Embedding with Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
summary: Within a hybrid quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics approach a small region of a large atomistic system is described quantum mechanically, while the rest of the system is represented by a classical force field. Despite this, the computational cost of the quantum calculation severely limits the accessible simulation and sampling time. Replacing the quantum calculation with a machine learning interatomic potential (MLIP) trained on quantum reference data can greatly increase the accessible simulation time. However, the accuracy and efficiency strongly depend on the specific way in which the MLIP incorporates information about the classical (electrostatic) environment. Here, we demonstrate that existing strategies based purely on features derived from an external electric field fail to distinguish certain environments, ultimately limiting their accuracy. As a solution, we propose an extension to the equivariant TensorNet architecture that mitigates this shortcoming by incorporating classical atoms close to the quantum region into the message-passing scheme, combined with features derived from the electric field for describing the environment farther away. We show that this combination achieves higher accuracy than either approach alone.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出在等变TensorNet架构中把靠近量子区的经典原子纳入消息传递，并用外部电场特征描述远处环境，从而提升ML/MM嵌入模拟的精度与效率。
AI.motivation: QM/MM中量子计算成本高，限制模拟与采样时间；用MLIP替代量子计算可提速，但精度与效率高度依赖MLIP如何引入经典静电环境信息。仅依赖外部电场特征的现有策略无法区分某些环境，限制精度。
AI.method: 证明仅用电场特征的策略存在环境不可区分问题；提出等变TensorNet的扩展：将量子区附近的经典原子加入消息传递，远处环境则用电场特征描述，二者结合。
AI.result: 该组合策略的精度高于单一方法（纯电场特征或纯近邻原子消息传递）。
AI.conclusion: 近邻经典原子的显式消息传递与远场电场特征互补，是提升MLIP嵌入QM/MM模拟精度与效率的有效方案。

title: Surface Hopping Dynamics on Adiabatic States Propagated with Real-Time TDDFT
summary: Real-time time-dependent density functional theory (RT-TDDFT) is widely used to simulate ultrafast electron dynamics, but it is usually coupled to the nuclei through the mean-field Ehrenfest approximation, which cannot describe wavepacket branching and violates detailed balance. Surface hopping avoids these problems, but has not previously been combined with RT-TDDFT because real-time propagation does not directly provide the necessary adiabatic states. In this work we introduce an energy-scaled time-dependent Kohn--Sham (TDKS) propagation scheme, motivated by the quantum adiabatic theorem. Scaling widens the separation between electronic and nuclear timescales, so that each propagated state follows the adiabatic surface selected by its initial condition: either the ground state or a non-Aufbau self-consistent-field ($Δ$SCF) solution. The propagation thereby avoids the convergence failures of static SCF solvers in regions of strong nonadiabatic coupling. Because the independently propagated states are complex-valued and not mutually orthogonal, we reformulate the mapping approach to surface hopping (MASH) in a complex adiabatic basis and introduce a dynamical transition orbital (DTO) gauge that restores a well-defined particle--hole representation for evaluating time-derivative couplings and nonadiabatic coupling vectors. Applied to the photoisomerization of \textit{trans}-diimide, the scheme converges systematically as the scaling factor is increased and yields an excited-state lifetime in good agreement with previous nonadiabatic simulations based on static SCF.\@ These results establish real-time propagation as an efficient and numerically stable route to the adiabatic states and couplings required for first-principles surface hopping.

AI.tldr: 提出能量缩放实时TDKS传播方案，使每步传播态跟随绝热面，并将MASH面跳跃推广到复绝热基与DTO规范，实现了RT-TDDFT与面跳跃的首次结合。
AI.motivation: RT-TDDFT常与Ehrenfest平均场近似耦合核运动，但无法描述波包分叉且违反细致平衡；面跳跃能避免这些问题，却无法与RT-TDDFT结合，因为实时传播不直接给出所需的绝热态。
AI.method: 受量子绝热定理启发，引入能量缩放的TDKS传播：放大电子与核时间尺度分离，使各传播态沿其初态（基态或非Aufbau ΔSCF解）所选的绝热面演化，从而避开强非绝热耦合区的静态SCF收敛问题；又因各态复值且非正交，将MASH映射面跳跃改写到复绝热基，并提出动力跃迁轨道（DTO）规范恢复粒子–空穴表示，用于求时间导数耦合与非绝热耦合矢量。
AI.result: 在trans-二亚胺光异构化算例中，随缩放因子增大系统性收敛，得到与既往静态SCF非绝热模拟相符的激发态寿命。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了实时传播作为获取第一性原理面跳跃所需绝热态与耦合的高效、数值稳定途径。

title: The Role of Electron-Nuclear Coupling on Chemical and Physical Processes
summary: Over the last few decades, Born-Oppenheimer (BO) and Born-Oppenheimer-Huang (BOH) treatments for electron-nuclear equation of motion have been considered as the cornerstone for qualitative as well as quantitative exploration and understanding of chemical and physical processes. The BO approximation due to the large mass difference between electrons and nuclei as well as the energy separation among the electronic states could able to predict some of the processes (chemical and physical) satisfactorily at lower energy regime. Such approximation (BO) quite often fails for those cases with the involvement of excited electronic states, in particular, due to the coupling among the states. On the other hand, the BO treatment provides two important quantities, namely, the adiabatic potential energy surfaces (PESs) and the nonadiabatic coupling terms (NACTs) determining the forces, which control the motion of the nuclei in a molecule. The NACTs play a major role in photoexcitation spectra, charge transfer chemical reactions, ferroelectric property and other processes, where significant anomalies are observed between single and multiple PES(s) results. Since the NACTs often exhibit singularity at the close vicinity of degenerate states forming conical intersections (CIs), such coupling terms could break the symmetry of the molecular processes changing the observables qualitatively.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了Born-Oppenheimer与Born-Oppenheimer-Huang处理电子-核运动方程的方法，指出BO近似在低能区可较好地预测化学物理过程，但在激发态耦合情形下常失效；并强调非绝热耦合项(NACTs)在圆锥交叉(CI)处出现奇异性，会定性改变分子过程的对称性与可观测量。
AI.motivation: BO/BOH处理是理解化学与物理过程的基石，但BO近似在涉及激发电子态及其耦合时往往失效。需要阐明绝热势能面与NACTs在控制核运动中的作用，并揭示NACTs在简并态附近的奇异性如何破坏过程对称性。
AI.method: 概念性/综述性分析：比较BO与BOH处理，讨论BO近似成立依据（电子核质量差、电子态能量间隔），分析绝热PESs与NACTs作为决定核运动的力，并考察NACTs在圆锥交叉附近的奇异行为。
AI.result: BO近似在低能区对部分化学物理过程预测良好；但在激发态参与、尤其态间耦合显著时失效。NACTs在光激发谱、电荷转移反应、铁电性质等过程中起主要作用，单PES与多PES结果间出现显著差异。NACTs在简并态附近呈奇异性并形成CI，可破坏分子过程对称性、定性改变可观测量。
AI.conclusion: 需超越单一BO绝热图像，重视非绝热耦合与圆锥交叉效应，才能正确描述激发态动力学及相关可观测量。

title: General-purpose foundation models surpass specialized ones on chemical property prediction tasks
summary: Foundation models (FMs) learn reusable representations from large collections of unlabeled data. In chemistry the corresponding data mainly consists of molecular structures, which are abundant, whereas experimental measurements are scarce. Chemical FMs such as ChemBERTa and MoLFormer were therefore trained on diverse molecular structures to enable fine-tuning on small experimental datasets (less than 100 datapoints in most realistic scenarios) and subsequent property prediction. At the same time, general-purpose FMs such as GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 were trained on virtually all publicly available data, including knowledge of the humankind on molecular properties and laws governing them. Here we compare accuracies of chemical and general-purpose FMs on tasks from various areas of chemistry. Strikingly, general-purpose GPT-6 Astra outperforms the currently eligible chemical FMs on five physicochemical and quantum-chemical regression tasks when only 60 experimental datapoints are available. Only when provided 10x datapoints do the best chemical FMs reach performance of GPT-6 Astra: on 1,000 and 10,000 points they show performance on par with Astra on 60 and 1,000 points, respectively. Thus, counterintuitively, frontier general-purpose FMs are better suited for guiding chemical research in data-scarce areas than specialized chemical FMs, suggesting that learning relevant primitives (e.g. chemical structures) does not substitute training on relevant humankind knowledge.

AI.tldr: 在化学数据稀缺场景（仅60个实验数据点）下，通用前沿模型GPT-6 Astra在多个物化/量子化学回归任务上优于专用化学基础模型（ChemBERTa、MoLFormer），化学模型需约10倍数据量才能追平。
AI.motivation: 化学基础模型通常在小分子结构上预训练，以便在少量实验数据上微调；而通用基础模型在几乎所有公开数据上训练，隐含了大量分子性质与化学规律知识。作者质疑：学好像化学结构这样的"相关基元"是否真能替代对相关人类知识的训练。
AI.method: 在多个化学领域的任务上，对比化学专用基础模型与通用基础模型（GPT-6 Astra、Claude Opus 5.5）的精度；重点考察物化与量子化学回归任务，并系统改变可用实验数据量（60、60×10、1,000、10,000点）进行微调/评估。
AI.result: 仅用60个实验数据点时，GPT-6 Astra在五项物化与量子化学回归任务上超过现有合格化学基础模型；化学基础模型需大约10倍数据才达到Astra的表现——即1,000点≈Astra在60点、10,000点≈Astra在1,000点。
AI.conclusion: 与直觉相反，在数据稀缺领域，前沿通用基础模型比专用化学基础模型更适合指导化学研究；说明学习相关基元（如分子结构）不能替代在相关人类知识上的训练。

title: Estimating Irving-Kirkwood pressure profiles from per-atom virial and density profiles: a closure for the contour-dependent term in planar liquid films
summary: The local pressure tensor of an inhomogeneous fluid is not unique. Two tangential profiles are in common use in planar simulations: the Irving-Kirkwood (IK) profile, which requires a dedicated pass over every pair of atoms for every slab, and the per-atom virial (PAV) profile, which molecular-dynamics codes produce at negligible cost and coincides with the Harasima contour. The two differ by the derivative of a pair quantity, P_T^IK - P_T^PAV = dQ/dz. We show that, for Lennard-Jones free-standing films, Q(z) can be predicted from the density profile and the bulk radial distribution function of the coexisting liquid: under the closure rho2(r1,r2) ~ rho(z1) rho(z2) g(r12), with a pair-local interpolation of g between its liquid and dilute limits, Q is a double integral of rho(z) against a kernel built from u'(r) g(r). The estimator P_T^IK,est = P_T^PAV + dQ/dz is tested against IK profiles measured on the same trajectories for 20 films (thicknesses 7-25 sigma, three cutoff radii, two temperatures): the root-mean-square residual is 0.001-0.002 epsilon/sigma^3, against 0.010-0.021 for the uncorrected profile, and Q, the amount that the contour choice transfers between the two interfaces of a film with non-equivalent surfaces, is recovered to within 0.6% of the surface tension. Applied to the normal component, the same closure removes 83-92% of the spurious structure of the per-atom zz profile, a test that needs no IK run. Its mixture form is validated on three two-component films with an adsorbate unequally distributed between their faces, where it resolves the tension of each face; a clean face recovers the tension of the pure film.

AI.tldr: 该文提出可从密度分布与体相径向分布函数预测Irving-Kirkwood与per-atom virial两种切向压力剖面之差，给出低成本的P_T^IK闭包估计量。
AI.motivation: 平面模拟中常见的两种切向压力剖面（IK与PAV/Harasima）不唯一，IK需对每层逐一扫描所有原子对、代价高；二者相差dQ/dz。作者希望用廉价可得的PAV剖面加解析修正来近似IK剖面。
AI.method: 在闭合假设rho2(r1,r2)≈rho(z1)rho(z2)g(r12)下，对g在液态与稀薄极限间做pair-local插值，把Q(z)写成rho(z)与由u'(r)g(r)构成的核函数的双重积分，从而得到估计量P_T^IK,est = P_T^PAV + dQ/dz；并推广到法向分量与混合物形式。
AI.result: 在20个Lennard-Jones自由液膜（厚7–25σ、三种截断半径、两个温度）上，估计量与同一轨迹实测IK剖面的RMS残差为0.001–0.002 ε/σ³（未修正为0.010–0.021）；Q（两界面间传递的量）恢复误差在表面张力0.6%以内。法向zz分量上消除83–92%的虚假结构；三个双组分膜上可分辨各面张力，洁净面恢复纯膜张力。
AI.conclusion: 该闭包提供了廉价而准确的IK压力剖面估计方法，并可推广至法向分量与多组分体系，用于区分非等价界面的张力。

title: Second-order Bethe-Salpeter kernels: the interplay of vertex-corrected quasiparticle energies and the screened interaction
summary: We study second-order Bethe-Salpeter kernels generated by truncating an iterative formulation of Hedin's equations after the second cycle. Starting from the Hartree-Fock or the $GW$ self-energy, whose first cycles correspond to TDHF and $GW$+BSE, we obtain the second-cycle kernel by differentiating the first-cycle correlation self-energy with the interacting correlation function replaced by the non-interacting one, and evaluate it in the static limit of the effective kernel. Using fixed restricted Hartree-Fock orbitals, we benchmark 30 singlet and 28 triplet excitation energies for seven small molecules (six for the triplets) against the theoretical best estimates from QUEST v1.2. The second cycle lowers the mean absolute error (MAE) in both sequences. For the $GW$ sequence, the MAE decreases from 0.63 to 0.29 eV (singlets), on par with ADC(2) (0.30 eV), and from 0.43 to 0.38 eV (triplets). BSE$^{(2)}$@HF removes the triplet instabilities of TDHF and yields MAEs of 0.43 and 0.38 eV, or 0.31 and 0.30 eV when the Tamm-Dancoff approximation is applied in all cycles. Assigning the statically screened interaction $W_0$ to the exchange part of the $GW$ self-energy counts second-order screening twice in the second-cycle kernel and strongly blueshifts valence excitations. Without this double counting, dressing the exchange-type terms with $W_0$ lowers the singlet MAE from 0.37 to 0.29 eV but leaves the triplets nearly unchanged. Replacing second-order Green's function (GF2) quasiparticle energies by vertex-corrected ones in the same kernel raises excitation energies by about 0.7 eV, improving Rydberg but degrading valence excitations. A perturbative dynamical correction of the kernel blueshifts valence excitations by 0.3-0.4 eV and increases the errors of all full-matrix BSE$^{(2)}$ variants. The consistent improvement over the first cycle suggests that higher cycles are worth pursuing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Hedin方程迭代二阶（第二循环）生成的Bethe-Salpeter核，在固定的RHF轨道上对7个小分子的单/三重激发能进行基准测试，发现第二循环显著降低误差，接近ADC(2)水平。
AI.motivation: 检验在Hedin方程迭代中超越第一循环（TDHF、GW+BSE）的二阶BSE核能否系统性地改善激发能精度，并厘清二阶筛分、顶点修正、动力学修正等各效应的影响。
AI.method: 截断Hedin方程于第二循环生成二阶BS核：由第一循环关联自能对相互作用关联函数求导（将后者替换为非相互作用形式）得到，并取有效核的静态极限；起点为HF或GW自能。在固定RHF轨道上对30个单重态和28个三重态激发能进行基准测试，对照QUEST v1.2理论最佳估计，并考察W0交换项、GF2准粒子能、微扰动力学修正等变体。
AI.result: 第二循环普遍降低MAE：GW序列单重态从0.63降至0.29 eV（与ADC(2)的0.30 eV相当），三重态从0.43降至0.38 eV；BSE(2)@HF消除TDHF三重态不稳定性，MAE为0.43/0.38 eV，TDA下为0.31/0.30 eV。将W0赋给GW自能交换部分导致二阶筛分双重计数并强烈蓝移价激发；去除双重计数后单重态MAE由0.37降至0.29 eV，三重态几乎不变。用顶点修正准粒子能替代GF2约升高0.7 eV（改善Rydberg、恶化价激发）；微扰动力学修正蓝移价激发0.3–0.4 eV并增大各full-matrix BSE(2)变体误差。
AI.conclusion: 第二循环相对第一循环的一致改进表明更高循环值得继续研究；但需注意W0双重计数、准粒子能与动力学修正带来的偏差。

title: Benchmarking One-Dimensional Quantum Lattice Boltzmann Methods on Quantum Hardware
summary: Classical computational fluid dynamics (CFD) methods encounter significant computational bottlenecks in large systems and at high Reynolds number flows due to the rapid increase in degrees of freedom, even on flagship supercomputers. As quantum computers emerge, the Quantum Lattice Boltzmann Method (QLBM) has been proposed as a quantum-native alternative for solving fluid dynamics problems. However, until recently, nearly all studies have relied on classical quantum simulators rather than real quantum hardware. This study presents a benchmark of a one-dimensional QLBM implementation executed on three different IBM Quantum hardware. We design and test a quantum circuit for the advection-diffusion equation using amplitude encoding, a Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook (BGK)-type collision operator, and a streaming step with periodic boundary conditions. Our numerical experiments evaluate transpiled two-qubit gate count, total circuit depth, runtime, and accuracy metrics including maximum absolute error ($L_\infty$ norm) and root-mean-square error (RMSE). We find that the present collision and streaming operators dominate the overall cost and become the primary scalability bottleneck on current hardware. To mitigate the prohibitive cost of full quantum state tomography on hardware-based benchmarking exercises, we introduce a sampler-based measurement strategy that reconstructs macroscopic density fields directly from computational-basis measurements. This approach substantially reduces measurement overhead while preserving the expected advection-diffusion dynamics on hardware. These results provide a quantitative assessment of QLBM performance in the noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) regime and identify the principal algorithmic and experimental limitations that must be addressed for QLBM to become viable for fluid dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本研究在IBM三台真实量子硬件上对一维量子格子玻尔兹曼方法（QLBM）进行了基准测试，求解对流-扩散方程，并发现碰撞与流动操作子是当前的主要可扩展性瓶颈，同时提出基于采样的测量策略以降低测量开销。
AI.motivation: 经典CFD在大规模系统和高雷诺数流动中自由度急剧增加，计算瓶颈显著。QLBM作为量子原生的替代方案被提出，但此前几乎全部研究依赖经典量子模拟器而非真实量子硬件，缺乏对NISQ时代实际性能的定量评估。
AI.method: 设计并测试了用于对流-扩散方程的量子电路，采用振幅编码、BGK型碰撞算子、周期边界条件的流动（streaming）步骤；在三台IBM量子硬件上执行转译后的电路，评估双量子比特门数量、总电路深度、运行时间及精度（L∞范数最大绝对误差、RMSE）。此外提出基于采样的测量策略，直接从计算基测量重构宏观密度场，以替代代价高昂的全量子态层析。
AI.result: 碰撞与流动算子主导了整体成本，成为当前硬件上的主要可扩展性瓶颈；基于采样的测量策略大幅降低测量开销，同时在硬件上保持了预期的对流-扩散动力学；给出了QLBM在NISQ区域性能的定量评估。
AI.conclusion: QLBM在NISQ硬件上尚不实用，需解决碰撞/流动算子成本与噪声等主要算法和实验限制，才能使其在流体力学中具备可行性。

title: Machine Learning-Enabled Time-Skipping Method: Theory and Perturbation-Based Verification
comment: 22 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to Theoretical and Applied Mechanics Letters
summary: Simulating the time evolution of practical mechanics problems requires many time steps. This cost is further compounded by the iterative nature of implicit solvers. We present a cycle-based Machine Learning-enabled Time-skipping (MLT) method. In each cycle, several time steps are skipped, a machine learning (ML) prediction bridges the gap to initialize one solver step, and the physics-based solver then runs for several steps to correct any accumulated errors. Using the Implicit Function Theorem, we derive first-order estimates that characterize how ML prediction errors propagate. These estimates identify when errors remain bounded across cycles and guide the choice of cycle parameters, independent of model architecture. We verify these estimates on the Allen-Cahn equation and a forced variant using controlled synthetic perturbations that emulate ML errors. Wall-clock measurements confirm the theoretical speedup is realizable in practice. The MLT method provides a robust framework for accelerating time-marching in dynamic simulations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于周期的机器学习时间跳跃（MLT）方法：每周期用ML预测跨越多步、再由隐式求解器校正，并用隐函数定理给出误差传播估计以指导参数选择，在Allen-Cahn方程上验证了理论的加速效果。
AI.motivation: 实际力学问题的时间演化仿真需要大量时间步，隐式求解器的迭代特性进一步放大计算成本，亟需在不破坏稳定性和精度前提下加速时间推进。
AI.method: 采用周期式流程：每个周期先跳过若干时间步，由机器学习预测桥接并初始化一次求解器步，然后让基于物理的隐式求解器再运行若干步以修正累积误差；利用隐函数定理推导一阶误差传播估计，刻画ML预测误差如何跨周期传播，从而判断误差是否有界并指导周期参数选择，且不依赖模型结构。
AI.result: 在Allen-Cahn方程及其带强迫项变体上，用受控合成扰动模拟ML误差，验证了误差估计的准确性；实际墙钟时间测量表明理论预测的加速在实践中有望实现。
AI.conclusion: MLT为动力仿真中的时间推进加速提供了稳健框架，其误差有界性分析与参数选择准则具有架构无关性，兼顾物理一致性与计算效率。

title: Feature-preserving interface reconstruction using piecewise circles and cusps
comment: 55 pages, 30 figures. Code and benchmark data: https://github.com/jerrywliu/interface-reconstruction/releases/tag/jcp-submission-2026-10-22-r1
summary: We present a geometric interface reconstruction method for Volume-of-Fluid (VOF) simulations that captures both curved interfaces and sharp features using only volume fraction data. We represent interfaces with linear facets, circular arcs, and corner facets formed by two lines or arcs joined within a single cell. We first propagate local orientation constraints through a graph and merge cells to resolve ambiguities, treating topological consistency as a first-class constraint. An optional conservative refinement improves $C^0$ continuity while preserving local volume constraints. Users can independently enable circular facets, corner facets, cell merging, and continuity refinement to balance accuracy and computational cost. In its simplest configuration, our method provides a fast local line-fitting scheme competitive with state-of-the-art PLIC methods. On standard static benchmarks, the full configuration reconstructs identifiable lines, circles, and sufficiently resolved corners to numerical precision on coarse, perturbed Cartesian meshes. On varying-curvature interfaces, it achieves third-order convergence in facet-gap error and approximately first-order convergence in curvature error. These results demonstrate global volume conservation and accurate reconstruction of curved and corner features.

AI.tldr: 提出一种仅用体积分数数据的VOF界面几何重构方法，用直线段、圆弧及拐角面片表示界面，通过图传播取向约束与单元合并保证拓扑一致性，可选择性启用各模块以平衡精度与开销。
AI.motivation: 现有VOF几何重构（如PLIC）仅用直线段，难以同时刻画弯曲界面与尖角等尖锐特征；同时局部重构缺乏拓扑一致性，导致歧义。
AI.method: 以线性面片、圆弧面片及单单元内两线/两弧拼接的拐角面片表示界面；通过图结构传播局部取向约束并合并单元以消除歧义，将拓扑一致性作为一等约束；可选保守细化在保持局部体积约束下提升C0连续性；圆弧、拐角、单元合并、连续性细化均可独立开关。
AI.result: 最简配置性能与先进PLIC相当；完整配置在粗化扰动笛卡尔网格上以数值精度重构直线、圆及充分分辨的拐角；变曲率界面上面片间隙误差达三阶收敛、曲率误差约一阶收敛，且全局体积守恒。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在保持体积守恒的前提下统一处理弯曲与尖角特征，模块化设计可按需权衡精度与成本。

title: AMPERe: an exactly divergence-free quadrature-by-expansion evaluator for near-surface Biot--Savart and virtual-casing fields in fusion geometries
summary: Accurate magnetic-field evaluation on and near current-carrying surfaces is a recurring computational bottleneck in magnetic-confinement fusion. As targets approach the source surface, Biot--Savart and virtual-casing kernels become singular, causing standard Gauss--Legendre and upsampled trapezoidal quadratures to lose accuracy. We introduce AMPERe, a quadrature-by-expansion (QBX) evaluator for vector magnetostatic kernels on general three-dimensional, non-axisymmetric tokamak and stellarator geometries. The method develops a spherical-harmonic QBX formulation for the vector Biot--Savart and virtual-casing (Stratton--Chu) fields and expresses the resulting magnetic field as the analytic curl of a regular-solid-harmonic vector potential. This construction yields a divergence-free discrete field at every expansion order, provides analytic derivatives, and enables an a priori separation of truncation, quadrature, and geometric errors. On the rotating-ellipse benchmark of Malhotra et al. [1], QBX maintains a relative error of 2--5 x 10^{-6} throughout the near-surface regime at distance-independent cost, whereas upsampled trapezoidal quadrature exhibits O(1) errors and requires node counts scaling as (h/d)^2. AMPERe is implemented as a header-only, performance-portable Kokkos library supporting CPU and GPU backends, with target-specific and local-correction accelerations validated against the baseline. The method is further demonstrated on realistic Wendelstein 7-X configurations, including sheet-current and virtual-casing field evaluations.

AI.tldr: 提出 AM PERe，一种用于三维非轴对称托卡马克与仿星器几何上向量磁静核的 QBX（quadrature-by-expansion）求值器，解决近源面处核奇异导致的标准求积失准问题，并实现为 Kokkos 头文件库。
AI.motivation: 磁约束聚变中，电流面及近表面的磁场精确评估是反复出现的计算瓶颈。当目标点靠近源面时，Biot–Savart 与 virtual-casing 核趋于奇异，标准 Gauss–Legendre 与上采样梯形求积会严重损失精度。需要一种在近表面区域保持精度、且成本不随距离恶化的方法。
AI.method: 发展球谐 QBX 形式，用于向量 Biot–Savart 与 virtual-casing（Stratton–Chu）场；将磁场表示为正则实心球谐向量势的解析旋度，从而在任意展开阶数下得到无散离散场，提供解析导数，并实现截断误差、求积误差与几何误差的先验分离。实现为 header-only、性能可移植的 Kokkos 库，支持 CPU/GPU 后端，并加入目标特定与局部修正加速。
AI.result: 在 Malhotra 等人的旋转椭圆基准上，QBX 在整个近表面区域保持 2–5×10^-6 的相对误差且成本与距离无关；而上采样梯形求积出现 O(1) 误差，且所需节点数按 (h/d)^2 增长。加速方案已与基线对照验证，并在 Wendelstein 7-X 的实际位形上演示（含 sheet-current 与 virtual-casing 场评估）。
AI.conclusion: AM PERe 为托卡马克/仿星器近表面磁场的精确、高效评估提供了一种无散、可解析求导、误差可先验分离且性能可移植的 QBX 方案，克服了传统求积在奇异核下的瓶颈。

title: High-fidelity simulation and reduced-order modeling of optical pumping in quantum devices
summary: Spatially resolved modeling of optically pumped alkali-metal vapors requires the solution of a high-dimensional nonlinear diffusive quantum master equation (DQME) coupled to state-dependent light propagation. We develop a structure-preserving computational framework for this coupled three-dimensional system in the high-pressure limit. The high-fidelity solver combines second-order finite differences, explicit pseudo-time marching, and an exponential-integrator discretization of the light-propagation equation. The scheme preserves the density-matrix trace, while a derived global pseudo-time-step restriction guarantees nonnegative, bound-preserving population updates and frozen-coefficient $1$-norm stability. In the absence of a closed-form solution for the general coupled problem, the solver is verified against complementary analytical reductions, pumping-rate asymptotics, and a light-propagation invariant, all of which are accurately recovered. Tensorized GPU implementation reduces the per-iteration cost by more than two orders of magnitude relative to a single-core CPU. For repeated parameter queries, we further construct an intrusive POD--Galerkin reduced-order model. The quadratic spin-exchange term is treated by an exact nonlinear quadratic expansion, whereas the nonpolynomial and nonlocal optical-pumping term is hyper-reduced using the discrete empirical interpolation method. At out-of-sample parameter points, the reduced model closely reproduces the full-order population and polarization fields while achieving speedup of more than \(7\times10^3\) relative to the single-core CPU full-order solver. The resulting hierarchy connects verified high-fidelity simulation with efficient reduced-order prediction for spatially resolved alkali-metal spin dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一套保结构的高保真数值框架，用于求解高压极限下空间分辨光抽运碱金属蒸气中高维非线性扩散量子主方程与态依赖光传播的耦合三维系统，并在其基础上建立侵入式POD-Galerkin降阶模型实现快速参数预测。
AI.motivation: 空间分辨建模光抽运碱金属蒸气需要求解高维非线性扩散量子主方程（DQME）并与态依赖光传播耦合，该耦合系统缺乏解析解且计算代价高，因此既需要可靠、保结构的数值求解器，也需要面向重复参数查询的高效降阶预测方法。
AI.method: 高保真求解器采用二阶有限差分、显式伪时间推进与光传播方程的指数积分器离散；方案保持密度矩阵迹，并导出全局伪时间步限制以保证布居更新非负、保界及冻结系数1-范数稳定。GPU张量化实现加速每迭代开销。降阶方面构造侵入式POD–Galerkin模型：自旋交换二次项采用精确非线性二次展开，非多项式非局域光抽运项用离散经验插值法（DEIM）超缩减。
AI.result: 求解器通过互补解析简化、抽运速率渐近解及光传播不变量验证，均被精确复现；张量化GPU实现使单次迭代成本相比单核CPU降低两个数量级以上。降阶模型在样本外参数点紧密复现全阶布居与极化场，相比单核CPU全阶求解器加速超过7×10³倍。
AI.conclusion: 所建立的层级化方法将经验证的高保真仿真与高效降阶预测相衔接，为空间分辨碱金属自旋动力学提供了可靠且实用的计算工具。

title: Query-Efficient Quantum Multi-Objective Optimization for Materials Configuration Search via Bayesian Weight Selection
summary: Materials design is a multi-objective problem, and recent advances in quantum optimization make it possible to bring quantum solvers to bear on such problems. The realistic near-term win, though, is not raw quantum advantage but making an expensive, noisy quantum solver usable by spending its calls wisely. Quantum Approximate Multi-Objective Optimization (QAMOO) traces a Pareto front by solving a family of scalarized Ising problems, one per objective-weight vector, with QAOA --- but chooses those weights \emph{non-adaptively}, sampling them at random, blind to what it has already found. We recast weight selection as \emph{multi-objective Bayesian optimization}: our method, BW-QAMOO (Bayes-Weighted QAMOO), picks each next weight by expected hypervolume improvement (EHVI) under a Gaussian-process (GP) surrogate over the weight-to-objective map. On a frustrated alloy-configuration benchmark across $m\in\{3,4\}$ objectives and $n\in\{10,11,12\}$ sites, BW-QAMOO reaches the same Pareto hypervolume as QAMOO's random sampling with a median 33% fewer scalarized solves across the 90/95\% targets and 60--74\% fewer than a uniform-grid baseline), on a genuine (simulated) QAOA solver; a paired Wilcoxon test confirms the saving is significant, and the advantage grows with the objective count m as the weight simplex expands and blind sampling wastes more of the budget. This is a \emph{query-efficiency} result, and we close with the open challenges on the path to real alloy data and hardware.

AI.tldr: 将 QAMOO 的权重选择重构为多目标贝叶斯优化，用高斯过程代理与 EHVI 自适应选择下一组权重，在相同 Pareto 超体积下显著减少标量化求解次数。
AI.motivation: 材料设计是多目标问题，量子优化有望介入；但近期现实收益不在于原始量子优势，而在于让昂贵且有噪声的量子求解器"少调用、用好调用"。QAMOO 原先以随机、非自适应方式采样权重向量，对已获得的信息视而不见，浪费预算。
AI.method: 提出 BW-QAMOO：把权重选择视为多目标贝叶斯优化，在"权重→目标"映射上建立高斯过程代理模型，用期望超体积改进（EHVI）逐次选择下一个权重向量，再交给 QAOA（每个权重求解一个标量化 Ising 问题）以描绘 Pareto 前沿。
AI.result: 在受挫合金构型基准上（m∈{3,4} 个目标，n∈{10,11,12} 个位点，使用模拟 QAOA 求解器），BW-QAMOO 达到与 QAMOO 随机采样相同的 Pareto 超体积，中位数减少 33% 的标量化求解（90/95% 目标下），比均匀网格基线少 60–74%；配对 Wilcoxon 检验显示该节省显著，且随目标数 m 增大优势扩大。
AI.conclusion: 这是一个查询效率（query-efficiency）层面的结果，而非量子优势声明；作者最后讨论了走向真实合金数据与真实硬件所面临的开放挑战。

title: A Momentum-weighted Interface Stabilization Approach for Fluid-Structure Interaction with Strong Added-Mass Effects
summary: Partitioned fluid-structure interaction (FSI) schemes permit the reuse of optimized standalone solvers but can become unstable under strong fluid added-mass effects, particularly when structural inertia is small relative to fluid inertia. This work traces the instability to the discrepancy between the interface pressure Schur complements of the monolithic and Dirichlet- Neumann partitioned systems, as revealed by a fixed-point analysis of the linearized FSI problem. Motivated by this analysis, a momentum-weighted interface stabilization (MWIS) is proposed, in which the interface pressure block of the fluid subproblem is augmented by an operator constructed from the fluid and structural interface momentum operators. The augmentation is consistent by construction, vanishing at convergence so that the monolithic solution is recovered. A sparse diagonal approximation of the operator, derived from element metrics, limits intersolver data exchange to quantities comparable in size to standard interface coupling data while requiring minimal modifications to the standalone solvers. Numerical experiments, spanning a linear model and established nonlinear FSI benchmarks, demonstrate improved coupling robustness in regimes of strong added-mass where the standard Dirichlet-Neumann scheme diverges.

AI.tldr: 提出动量加权界面稳定化（MWIS），通过在流体子问题界面压力块上添加由流体与结构界面动量算子构造的一致性算子，缓解强附加质量下的分区FSI不稳定。
AI.motivation: 分区FSI可复用独立求解器，但在流固质量比悬殊的强附加质量情形下易失稳，需要既能保持求解器模块化又能提升稳定性的方法。
AI.method: 对线性化FSI问题做不动点分析，将失稳归因于整体式与Dirichlet-Neumann分区系统界面压力Schur补的差异；据此设计MWIS，将流体子问题界面压力块用流体与结构界面动量算子进行增广，构造上一致（收敛时消失），并采用由单元度量导出的稀疏对角近似以限制跨求解器数据交换。
AI.result: 在强附加质量、标准Dirichlet-Neumann发散的工况下耦合鲁棒性提升；验证涵盖一个线性模型及多个非线性FSI基准算例。
AI.conclusion: Schur补差异解释了分区失稳机制，MWIS以低侵入、小通信开销的一致增广有效扩展了分区FSI的稳定适用范围。
